jobs.title: Asset/Move Coordinator I (Relocation Project Coordinator)
jobs.description:
Supports the Relocation Project Management (RPM) team at multiple campuses as needed in  
Furniture, Fixtures, and Equipment (FF&E) activities for all new, renovated and swing space projects  
which includes assistance in programming, specification, budget tracking, procurement coordination,  
scheduling with the construction team, installation, and punch list activities. Supports the RPM team in  
move management activities relating to move scope creation, bidding, analysis of bids, budget  
tracking, move coordination and scheduling, onsite move oversight and punch list activities to ensure  
complete functional occupancy of new and renovated buildings.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities:**

* Support the Furniture/Equipment/Relocation Project Management Services with emphasis in FF&E  
  selection, procurement coordination and purchasing for all such areas as identified by the District to  
  provide college the onsite FF&E and move-in/relocations management services. Responsibilities  
  include strategic oversight of all FF&E procurement, FF&E Installation, Pre-move, Move, and Post move/Close-out phase activities for specified assigned projects. Services shall be provided at the  
  direction of the College Project Director (CPD) and the Manager of Relocation Project Management  
  team.
* Assist with the procurement and purchasing of FF&E using best-value and/or low bid public  
  contracting.
* Support budget and schedule tracking efforts for FF&E and moves, and meet with relevant Project  
  Architects (A/E), Project Managers, and BUGs, to be able to prepare office layouts and work with  
  the occupants to plan furniture and equipment relocation of existing to the move location. Work  
  with vendors and/or movers to assist with filling in equipment and furnishings where there are  
  gaps.
* Coordinate and prepare a list of all new furniture and equipment needed for the project.
* Assist with the timely and successful onsite FF&E installation, punch-list sign-off and transition  
  during swing space, relocation and/or move into new buildings.
* Support the procurement of specialty contractors or Movers for installations, delivery, and/or  
  connections not covered by the FF&E vendors. Create detailed scope of work for Task Orders for  
  Contractors/Movers as necessary.
* Support the RPM in the working with the Project Interior Designer and the BUG user groups to  
  select and prepare a list of all furniture and equipment needed for the project.
* Assist in the onsite unlocking of all areas requiring access by the movers and others during the PreMove, Move, Installation and Post Move/Close-Out Phases and for the re-securing all such areas.
* Assist in the onsite coordination of all furniture and equipment deliveries with PMs, CPDs, Facility  
  Directors, and BUGs if applicable; work closely with Asset Management Team to coordinate all asset  
  tagging and disposition requirements, and Warranty Program Managers and other members of  
  program staff working towards close-out of projects.
* Maintain all FF&E, move management, moving and storage related documents, including proposals,  
  purchase orders, packing slips, time cards, shipping documents, freight bills, and invoices and  
  submit to the CPD in written form.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* High School Diploma.
* 1 year of related experience in Interior Design, Construction, Engineering, Moves/Relocations,  
  Facilities, or Furniture, Fixture and Equipment coordination/procurement.
* Ability to read architectural and furniture drawings.
* Knowledge of furniture and equipment specifications and procurement.
* Strong written and oral communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
* Attention to detail.
* Ability to be onsite at multiple colleges.
* Proficiency Microsoft Office and related word processing, spreadsheet, and database software.
* Flexibility in schedule and transportation to work at multiple locations based on assigned schedule.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Four-year Degree in the areas of Architecture, Interior Architecture, Interior Design,  
  Construction/Project Management, Facilities Management or related area required.
* Procurement, sourcing or asset management experience.
* Public Works experience.
* Knowledge/proficiency in AutoCAD software.
* Certification/Membership with CID, IIDA, AIA, IFMA, LEED.

**Job Description**

**Grow your career at Cedars-Sinai!**

Cedars-Sinai Medical Center has been named to the Honor Roll in U.S. News & World Report’s “Best Hospitals 2024-2025” rankings. At Cedars-Sinai, we take pride in hiring the best, most hard-working employees. Our dedicated doctors, nurses and staff reflect the culturally and ethnically diverse community we serve. As Cedars-Sinai largest philanthropic support group, the BOG includes more than 900 members dedicated to advancing the institutions mission. In this role, the PC will provide day-to-day operational and administrative support to assigned fundraisers and volunteer leaders. Key responsibilities include coordinating complex calendars and meetings, preparing agendas and briefing materials, supporting portfolio reviews, tracking action items and proposals, maintaining accurate information in fundraising and portfolio management systems, organizing donor and prospect materials, and assisting with stewardship and donor strategy activities. jobs.title: Retail Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Retail Project Coordinator

**GoldUnion US – Beverly Hills**

GoldUnion, a global leader in buying and selling precious metals, is rapidly expanding across California, with a goal of opening **25 locations by 2027**. We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Retail Project Coordinator to support and oversee our retail expansion efforts across the state.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working on-site, solving practical problems, and being directly involved in getting retail spaces ready for business.

**Position Overview**

As part of GoldUnion’s retail expansion team, the Retail Project Coordinator plays a key role in managing and supporting the build-out and launch of new branch locations. This position is focused on project coordination, vendor management, timeline tracking, and ensuring operational readiness from planning through grand opening.

This is a field-based role with a home base in **Beverly Hills, CA**, requiring **frequent travel** between branch locations throughout California. A company vehicle will be provided.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and oversee multiple retail expansion projects from pre-construction through store opening
* Work closely with contractors, vendors, and internal teams to ensure projects stay on schedule and meet company standards
* Track project timelines, deliverables, and milestones, ensuring timely completion of all phases
* Conduct site visits and walkthroughs to monitor progress, identify issues, and ensure quality control
* Serve as a point of contact between operations, construction teams, and external partners
* Assist in resolving on-site challenges and ensuring projects move forward efficiently
* Support final setup and readiness of new locations prior to opening
* Ensure each branch meets operational, safety, and brand standards before launch
* Travel between locations as needed to support multiple active projects

**Candidate Profile**

* Previous experience in project coordination, facilities coordination, construction, or retail build-outs preferred
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
* Experience working with contractors, vendors, or cross-functional teams
* Able to follow instructions, coordinate with others, and communicate clearly with internal teams
* Flexible schedule and willing to travel extensively across California
* Experience in retail expansion or construction project environments is a plus
* Strong work ethic, positive attitude, and willingness to learn are essential

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Salary:** $55,000 per year
* Company car provided
* Gas and hotels fully covered during travel

**Working Hours**

* Full-time, Monday through Friday 10am-6pm
* Occasional weekends based on business needs and branch opening schedules

**Location**

* Office currently based in **Beverly Hills, CA**
* Frequent travel to branch sites throughout California required

**Recruitment Process**

* Initial phone or video interview
* In-person interview with the operations leadership team

GoldUnion is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available as required by law.

GoldUnion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act. Background screenings and applicant information are handled in accordance with applicable laws.

The listed pay range reflects GoldUnion’s good-faith estimate for this position. Actual pay may vary based on lawful job-related factors. Commission and incentive earnings are performance-based and not guaranteed.

Offers of employment are contingent upon applicable lawful onboarding requirements and screenings.

jobs.title: Assistant Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sunny Days is seeking a full-time **Assistant Program Coordinator** for our California Early Intervention program. This fast-paced, high-volume, administrative position will support our team’s Program Coordinators with data entry, processing database reports, and a high volume of digital paperwork. It is a high impact role that helps fill the gaps so our programs can run smoothly! We are looking for a high-quality candidate with administrative experience, ideally in the field of early intervention and/or education. This is a **hybrid position**, with a preference for candidates **located within commuting distance of either Sacramento or Orange County, California**.

Sunny Days of California, Inc. provides quality, home-based, early intervention services to children birth to three years who have developmental delays and/or disabilities. Our family-centered, parent coaching approach guides families to incorporate support strategies into their daily routines, maximizing their child’s ability to participate in all aspects of their daily lives.

**What Sunny Days offers:**

* Competitive hourly rate ($22-$24/hr)
* Great benefits package - (401k,Medical, Dental and Vision)
* Positive and supportive work environment
* Hybrid position

**Duties include, but are not limited to**:

* Complete daily, time-sensitive data entry and filing
* Run reports and manage digital files
* Maintain comprehensive tracking of age outs, reports due, sessions scheduled, and other case-related deadlines
* Send welcome emails to families
* Maintain confidentiality of information regarding children and families (in accordance with HIPAA and/or State/Federal regulations)
* Assist Program Coordinators with additional tasks, as needed

This role is a key player in the coordination of services for children enrolled in our home-based, early intervention program by communicating via email, phone, and Zoom with various stakeholders. The Assistant Program Coordinator is also responsible for managing and processing a high volume of digital paperwork, tracking spreadsheets and database reports and ensuring compliance with our agency policies and contracts.

**To be effective in this role, candidates must:**

* Possess superior communication skills and have the ability to build and sustain relationships with a variety of stakeholders solely via email and phone
* Be highly organized and reliable with exceptional time management skills
* Be detail-oriented, finding enjoyment in precision and fitting the puzzle pieces together
* Have strong computer literacy and data management skills
* Be able to anticipate needs and think critically

**Minimum Requirements:**

* Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred
* Minimum of two years of administrative experience
* Computer literacy and data entry experience
* Bilingual English/Spanish/Vietnamese skills a plus!

Sunny Days is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, religious creed, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, reproductive health decision-making, or military or veteran status.

jobs.title: Production Coordinator (Fashion)
jobs.description:
**Production Coordinator (Fashion)**  
Santa Monica, CA (Onsite, 5 Days a Week)

At SYRN, we’re building more than a brand. We’re creating worlds women can step into. Rooted in self-expression, confidence, and intentional design, SYRN blends elevated craftsmanship with culturally resonant storytelling to create pieces that feel both aspirational and deeply personal.

**Job Description**

We’re looking for a highly organized, detail-driven Production Coordinator to help bring SYRN’s creative vision to life across e-commerce and campaign production. Reporting to the Creative Production Manager, you’ll keep projects moving from pre-production through final delivery, partnering with Operations, Product Development, Design, and Marketing, as well as the best-in-class production teams we collaborate with.

This role will sit at the intersection of project management and creative execution, ensuring every shoot is well planned, well run, and delivered to the highest standard. The ideal candidate brings a production background, takes ownership with confidence, stays composed in a dynamic environment, and has a refined eye for detail and aesthetics.

**What You’ll Do**

**Project Management & Timelines**

* Manage production timelines in partnership with Operations and Product Development, identifying and resolving schedule risks early
* Maintain clear visibility across active projects, deliverables, and deadlines for internal stakeholders and external partners
* Coordinate with Design and Marketing to align on product imagery, approvals, and asset needs
* Keep project trackers, shared drives, and production documentation organized and up to date

**Sample Management**

* Lead sample intake for e-commerce shoots, including purchase order creation with Operations
* Receive, log, and organize samples with precision, reconciling deliveries against style lists
* Manage sample distribution across marketing teams, as well as returns and courier logistics
* Partner cross-functionally to secure product on time for every shoot

**Shoot Production**

* Develop shot lists, style lists, and shoot documentation, and ensure all teams are fully prepared ahead of shoot day
* Support the development of creative decks and mood boards in partnership with the Creative Production Manager
* Coordinate logistics and schedules with producers, photographers, stylists, and crew
* Provide on-set support, overseeing product organization, shot tracking, and deliverables
* Oversee shoot wrap, including breakdown, product reconciliation, and final checks

**Post-Production**

* Prepare retouching decks with selects, file names, and file numbers for creative review
* Manage feedback rounds and revisions with retouchers and editors through final delivery
* Review final assets for accuracy, completeness, and brand standards, and maintain an organized archive

**What You’ll Bring**

* 2–3 years of experience in production, creative production, or production assistant roles, ideally within fashion, apparel, e-commerce, editorial, or agency environments
* Proven on-set experience across photo or video production, from pre-production through delivery
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple projects at once
* A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and a strong sense of ownership
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to build strong relationships across teams
* A refined eye for aesthetics and image quality
* Composed, thoughtful, and adaptable in a fast-paced environment
* Comfortable working within the intimates category, including on-set production with talent
* Able to work onsite five days a week, with flexibility on shoot days and occasional local travel to set locations
* Valid driver’s license; access to a vehicle preferred
* Nice to have: experience with Asana, Google Workspace, Canva, and Adobe Creative Suite or Figma

**What You’ll Gain**

End-to-end exposure to creative production at a fast-growing brand, working alongside world-class production partners. You’ll learn directly from our Creative Production Manager, grow your ownership over time, and play a meaningful role in shaping how SYRN’s creative comes to life.

**Equal Opportunity**

SYRN is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Pay: From $72,500.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Ability to Commute:

* Santa Monica, CA 90404 (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Social Media Coordinator, TikTok & Video
jobs.description:
At cabi, we're redefining what it means to build a fashion brand—one rooted in connection, confidence, and purpose. As a women's retail clothing company, we don't just design beautiful apparel; we create opportunities for women to express themselves, build community, and thrive both personally and professionally. Our culture is collaborative, entrepreneurial, and deeply people-first, and every team member plays a role in creating meaningful experiences for our Stylists and clients. If you're energized by creativity, inspired by empowering others, and excited to contribute to a brand that blends style with substance, you'll feel right at home here.

We are looking for a Social Media Coordinator to own cabi's TikTok presence end to end: concepting, shooting, editing, posting and engaging. You'll know what's trending this week, translate it into cabi's voice, and turn our collections, Stylists and clients into video people want to watch and share. Approximately 90% of the content you capture will go toward TikTok, with the other 10% going to other platforms.

This role is a great fit for a hands-on creator who is comfortable in front of and behind the camera. You'll partner closely with the marketing, design and Stylist-community teams, and edit video for Instagram and other cabi social channels.

We also use AI tools every day to work faster and smarter, from ideation to editing, and we're looking for someone excited to do the same.

**What You'll Do**

**Content creation and video production**

* Dedicate about 90% of captured content to TikTok, with the other 10% going to Instagram and other emerging social platforms.

* Publish content on TikTok daily, concepting, scripting, shooting and editing original videos alongside creator content and carousels: try-ons, styling tips, "one piece, five ways" capsule looks, behind-the-scenes, in-office content, TikTok trends and founder, CEO, or Stylist features.
* Shoot on phone and in studio, handling lighting, framing, audio and on-screen text so every video looks native to TikTok.
* Edit quickly in CapCut, TikTok's in-app editor, Adobe Premiere or similar, with sharp hooks in the first 2 seconds.
* Appear on camera when needed and direct talent, employees, Stylists and creators on set.

* Plan and coordinate content shoots, including shot lists, scheduling, talent, wardrobe and props.
* Attend cabi photo shoots, collection launches, Stylist events and conferences to capture behind-the-scenes and live content.

**Curation and community**

* Find, vet and repost content from cabi Stylists, clients and creators, with proper permissions and credit.
* Run Stitches, Duets and comment-reply videos to keep conversations going.
* Manage TikTok comments, DMs and mentions daily in cabi's voice, flagging customer-service issues to the right team.
* Partner with the Stylist-community team to give Stylists shareable content and simple TikTok how-tos.

**Planning and trends**

* Own the TikTok content calendar, tied to collection launches, seasonal drops and promotions.
* Track trending sounds, formats and fashion conversations daily and pitch timely ideas fast.
* Support TikTok LIVE sessions, influencer and creator partnerships, and TikTok Shop content as those programs grow.

* Partner with the paid social team to supply and adapt organic TikToks for Spark Ads and paid campaigns.

**Reporting**

* Track views, watch time, completion rate, shares, saves, follower growth and traffic to cabionline.com.
* Share a weekly performance recap and use the data to decide what to make more of.
* Repurpose winning TikToks for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Pinterest and Facebook.

**Cross-channel support (10%)**

* Repurpose top TikToks and edit video for Instagram and other platforms.
* Source trend and creative inspiration for the broader social calendar.
* Contribute TikTok and video data to bi-weekly and monthly social reports.

Other duties may be assigned.

  

**What You Bring**

* 2–4 years creating short-form video for a brand, ideally fashion, apparel, beauty or lifestyle.
* A portfolio of TikTok videos you concepted, shot and edited, with results you can speak to.
* Fluency in TikTok culture: trends, sounds, formats, the algorithm and what makes people stop scrolling.
* Strong editing skills in CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar, plus comfort shooting ona phone.

* Working knowledge of Instagram Reels and how short-form content translates across platforms.

* Experience with TikTok analytics and a habit of letting data shape the next video.
* Comfort on camera and confidence directing others.
* Clear writing for captions, on-screen text and comment replies.
* Organized, fast and calm with many deadlines; able to turn a trend around in 24 hours.

* Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets for tracking and recaps.
* Comfort working with minimal supervision in a fast-moving environment, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves wherever needed.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with TikTok Shop, TikTok LIVE or Spark Ads.
* Experience working with creators, influencers or a community of brand ambassadors.
* Familiarity with scheduling and listening tools such as Later, Sprout Social or Dash Hudson.
* Photography skills and basic design in Canva or Adobe.
* An eye for styling and a love of women's fashion.
* Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, film or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Regular use of AI tools for ideation, scripting or editing, and curiosity about how AI can change content creation.
* Experience in retail, fashion or direct sales.
* Experience coordinating video or photo shoots.

**What We Offer**

At cabi, we believe our people should be recognized for the impact they make. Our compensation philosophy provides fair, competitive pay based on the value and scope of each role, relevant experience and skills, and the market where the role is based.

* Hourly rate of pay $25 - $35. Total compensation may vary based on relevant exp

SALES REPRESENTATIVE / BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

**Elite Home Staging | Southern California**

**100% Commission | Unlimited Earning Potential | Up to $10,000+ Per Month**

Elite Home Staging is growing, and we are looking for a driven, competitive, relationship-focused salesperson who knows how to generate business, build relationships, and close deals.

If you are a natural salesperson who loves real estate, luxury homes, interiors, and design, this is an opportunity to turn your sales skills into a highly rewarding career.

**We are looking for someone who is hungry for success, motivated by commission, and confident enough to go out and create new business.**

ABOUT ELITE HOME STAGING

Elite Home Staging is one of Southern California's leading home-staging companies, specializing in beautifully designed staging for luxury properties. We work closely with real estate agents, brokers, developers, builders, and homeowners to help properties make a powerful first impression and sell successfully.

Our company has built a strong reputation in the Southern California real estate community, and we are continuing to expand our reach.

THE ROLE

We are seeking an experienced **Outside Sales Representative / Business Development professional** whose primary responsibility is to generate new business and grow Elite Home Staging's client base.

This is an active, field-based sales position. You will spend your time prospecting, visiting real estate offices, meeting agents, networking, developing relationships, following up with prospects, and closing new staging accounts.

You will have the opportunity to work directly with top-producing real estate agents, luxury brokers, developers, builders, and other industry professionals throughout Southern California.

**This is not an inside sales or desk job. We need someone who enjoys being out in the field, meeting people, creating opportunities, and bringing in business.**

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Generate new business through cold calling, prospecting, networking, office visits, referrals, and in-person meetings.
* Regularly visit real estate offices to introduce Elite Home Staging and develop new agent relationships.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective clients.
* Identify sales opportunities and confidently convert prospects into paying clients.
* Consistently follow up with leads and close new business.
* Develop relationships with real estate agents, brokers, developers, builders, and referral partners.
* Schedule consultations, presentations, and property appointments.
* Present Elite Home Staging's services with confidence and professionalism.
* Educate prospective clients on the value of professional home staging.
* Represent Elite Home Staging at broker events, networking functions, open houses, and industry events.
* Maintain relationships with existing clients while continuously developing new accounts.
* Meet and exceed monthly sales goals and business development targets.
* Work closely with our design and operations teams to ensure an exceptional client experience.

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

**REQUIRED:**

* Minimum of **2 years of outside sales experience**.
* Proven ability to prospect, develop relationships, and close sales.
* Comfortable with cold calling, in-person sales presentations, and business development.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Self-motivated and able to work independently in a field-based position.
* Highly organized with excellent follow-up and time-management skills.
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
* Comfortable working on a 100% commission compensation structure.

**PREFERRED:**

* Experience selling to real estate agents, brokers, builders, or developers.
* Background in luxury sales, home staging, furniture, interior design, or real estate.
* Existing relationships within the Southern California real estate community.

COMPENSATION & EARNING POTENTIAL

**100% Commission-Based Compensation**

* Opportunity to earn **up to $10,000 per month or more**, depending on sales performance.
* No income ceiling.
* Your earning potential is directly tied to your ability to generate and close business.
* Opportunity to build a valuable network and long-term book of business.

This position is ideal for a salesperson who is confident in their ability to sell, motivated by financial success, and excited by the opportunity to control their earning potential.

DESIGN INTEREST IS A MAJOR PLUS

You do not need to be an interior designer, but you should have a genuine interest in interior design, furniture, architecture, luxury homes, and current design trends.

Selling home staging is about more than selling furniture. It is about helping agents and homeowners position a property, create an emotional connection with buyers, and maximize the property's presentation.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We want someone who is:

* A natural hunter who enjoys bringing in new business.
* Competitive, ambitious, and goal-oriented.
* Confident walking into a real estate office and introducing themselves.
* Comfortable approaching new people and starting conversations.
* Persistent and excellent at follow-up.
* A strong closer who knows how to turn opportunities into sales.
* Professional and polished when working with luxury clientele.
* Energetic, outgoing, and relationship-driven.
* Motivated by commission and financial success.
* Independent, accountable, and results-oriented.
* Passionate about real estate, interiors, and design.

WHY ELITE HOME STAGING?

* Work with one of Southern California's leading home-staging companies.
* Build relationships with high-producing real estate professionals.
* Represent a beautiful, high-end service in an exciting industry.
* Enjoy significant commission-based earning potential.
* Work in a creative, entrepreneurial, and fast-growing environment.
* Opportunity to grow your client portfolio and professional network.

READY TO MAKE

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Bogart Construction is a licensed commercial general contractor with more than 30 years of experience delivering tenant improvements and ground-up projects nationwide. Our portfolio includes grocery, retail, restaurant, automotive, entertainment, and more. We are known for strong client partnerships, innovative solutions, and an unwavering commitment to safety and quality.

At Bogart Construction, our greatest asset is our people. We place a high value on investing not only in the growth of our company but also in the development and success of our team.

**Job Description**

The **Assistant Project Manager** (APM) supports the Project Manager in the planning, execution, and successful completion of commercial construction projects. This position will primarily support retail renovation, expansion, and ground-up projects, while developing the skills necessary to independently manage projects. The APM is responsible for project documentation, subcontractor administration, procurement tracking, compliance management, change order support, scheduling assistance, and coordination with field operations. The APM may be assigned to manage smaller projects up to approximately $3,000,000 in contract value under the direction of the Project Manager and Project Executive.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist the Project Manager with all phases of project execution from preconstruction through closeout.
* Manage assigned projects up to approximately $3,000,000 in contract value as directed.
* Obtain, submit, track, and distribute project submittals and Requests for Information (RFIs).
* Maintain project documentation including procurement logs, submittal logs, RFI logs, change order logs, drawing logs, meeting minutes, schedules, and closeout documents.
* Review drawing revisions, CCDs, SKs, and owner directives and identify potential cost and schedule impacts.
* Assist with subcontractor buyout, bid solicitation, contract administration, and procurement activities.
* Create the SWPPP book and apply for state and local SWPPP permits/NOIs for the project.
* Draft and issue letters of intent, purchase orders, and subcontracts as directed.
* Track subcontractor compliance requirements including insurance, contracts, labor compliance, and project-specific documentation.
* Assist with project cost tracking, change order preparation, owner pay applications, and subcontractor pay application review.
* Assist with schedule updates, procurement tracking, and identification of schedule risks.
* Coordinate owner-furnished and contractor-furnished material deliveries with field staff.
* Attend project meetings, subcontractor meetings, preconstruction meetings, and site visits as required.
* Create and distribute meeting minutes, weekly reports, and client-required project reporting.
* Support client compliance requirements including worker verification, labor documentation, audit preparation, project reporting, etc.
* Partner with Superintendents to identify and resolve project issues related to schedule, quality, procurement, and subcontractor performance.
* Assist with project closeout including punch lists, warranties, O&M manuals, as-builts, and turnover documentation.
* Attend pre-con meetings as required by PM or PX.

**General Requirements**

* Self-motivated and capable of working independently with minimal supervision.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational, time management, and problem-solving abilities.
* Professional demeanor and ability to maintain positive working relationships.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Adaptable and flexible to changing project requirements.
* Valid driver's license with acceptable driving record.
* Capability to maintain a standing or seated posture for prolonged periods.
* Dexterity to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and other business-related machines.
* Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new computer programs and software.
* Commitment to professional growth and continuing education.

**Specific Requirements**

* Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in commercial construction, retail construction, or ground-up construction.
* Ability to work from the main office or job sites and attend weekly staff meetings.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Procore, Bluebeam, and construction management software.
* Working knowledge of project scheduling software, including Microsoft Project, preferred.
* Ability to read and interpret plans, specifications, contracts, lease exhibits, and construction documents.
* Negotiation, dispute resolution, and financial/job cost accounting skills required.
* Understanding of project cost controls, change management, scheduling, and procurement processes.
* Knowledge of construction methods, materials, and industry regulations.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.
* Bachelor's Degree (or in progress) in Construction Management, Architecture, Construction Science, or a related field (or equivalent industry certification).
* Additional relevant work experience may be accepted as a substitute for a Bachelor's Degree.
* Reports directly to the Project Manager.

**Benefits:**

* 401(k) + matching
* Medical / Dental / Vision Insurance
* Paid Time Off
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program

**Position Summary:**

The Construction Project Coordinator oversees the defining scope, planning, implementation, tracking and completion/evaluation of projects which have a beginning, an end and specified deliverables. Must be able to reconcile construction activities and manage scope change during project and complete project within designated time frame and on budget.

Construction Project Coordinator must take ownership of projects they are assigned.

**Job Duties/Responsibilities:**

1. Hit Target Revenue provided

2. Contacting customers for projects once the pre-construction phase is complete.

3. Customer point of contact for on-site activities

4. Responsible for overall project success – being on time and under budget

5. Responsible for managing and delegating to Project Coordinator Assistants as needed

6. During construction phase, track and coordinate materials, schedule, timelines and budget and if necessary RFI log

7. Manage sub-contractors on current projects for construction activities

8. Schedule projects with all subcontractors and customers.

a. To do so, three things must be accomplished, in order:

i. Design drawings must be completed and approved by client

ii. Materials from vendors must have delivery date finalized

iii. Confirmation in writing from the client that onsite date is acceptable

9. Coordinating with Design Department to obtain all the necessary documentation for projects during construction phase

10. Provide regular updates to Management as requested

11. Responsible for receiving and inventory of the material as the first step of construction phase. Assist with Pickups/Deliveries if required.

12. Control Job Tickets and what is in job tickets

13. Coordinating with Project Coordinator Assistants as to Field Tech availability and forecasting field techs to projects

14. Create Hot Sheets for items that need to be addressed once the main body of work is completed and there are still minor things to complete

15. Travel to jobsite or offsite coordination meetings as required with Operations Manager, Supervisor, or Foreman

16. First day of work walk the job site with field techs and Field Tech Manager or Foreman

17. Assist with Pickups/Deliveries if required

18. Other responsibilities and tasks as assigned or needed

19. Responsible for creating and submitting Change Orders/Credit Memos during construction phase:

a. If client is requesting a change in scope, addition, or alternative solution

b. If on site conditions are not as specified in the project’s documentation

i. If questions arise from any of the above, report to Operations Manager for direction

ii. Change orders are to be submitted to Operations Manager for review/comment/approval

20. Update clients daily for work completed that day and anticipated completion date for the rest of the work

21. Responsible to maintain daily logs for onsite work

22. Responsible for Forecasting all projects during the weekly forecasting meeting held Tuesdays

23. Coordinating, setting up, and preparing for Weekly Huddles

24. Assist in closing of city permits - schedule final inspections with city department

25. Responsible for closeouts of the project with closeout docs completed such as test reports, As-built, OPOS, warranties, O&M, MSDS sheets, project manuals, AI reports etc.

26. Responsible for keeping project status updated on project management software

27. Responsible for sending the weekly billing to pre-construction project coordinator for ongoing projects

28. Coordinate project coordinator visits (PCV) requests from design team

29. Hold closeout documents meeting on Thursdays

30. Responsible for responding to clients within 24 hours

**Other Duties**

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

**Education and Experience**

* High school diploma (College or Business school desirable)
* A minimum of 2-5 years of experience in construction project management.
* Direct experience in construction field operations, including site visits and supervision, is highly beneficial.

**Skills and Abilities**

* Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing tasks, and meeting deadlines.
* Proficiency in construction management software, scheduling tools, and project management software.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with clients, contractors, and team members.
* Ability to identify and resolve issues promptly and efficiently.

**Physical Requirements**

This is primarily a sedentary office position, which requires the ability to occasionally bend, stoop, reach, lift, move and carry supplies and materials up to 40 lbs.

May also be required to physically attend off-site meetings, gather site-specific information and observations, and travel to multiple project locations.

**Qualification Requirements**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Job Type: Full-time

The Family Justice Center (the “Center”) is a warm and welcoming one-stop center for victims of interpersonal violence (IPV) -- domestic violence, sexual assault, child abuse, elder abuse and human trafficking. The Center serves victims and survivors regardless of their income, immigration status or location. The Center is a public-private partnership committed to creating a vibrant community free of coercion and fear. It supports the West Center located in Richmond, the Central Center in Concord, the East Center in Antioch, the South Center in Danville, and the Solano Center in Fairfield.

**POSITION SUMMARY**:

We are accepting applications for one full-time Program Coordinator. We provide generous fringe benefits, including paid holidays, paid annual and sick leave, health insurance coverage, dental and vision coverages, life insurance and retirement

benefits.

· Coordinate special projects (festivals, community listening sessions, workshops, informational meetings).

· Ability and willingness to learn in new areas and practices.

· Ability to travel.

· Bachelor’s Degree in a related field or equivalent work experience.

· Minimum of two years’ worth of experience relevant to the position: training, curriculum, development, program design, and implementation, coaching and victim advocacy.

**SPECIAL CONSIDERATION:**

· Ability to create effective social media posts.

· Excellence in website design and graphics.

· Superb writing skills.

· Ability to fix computers and troubleshoot technical issues.

· Interest in or experience with non-violence work.

· Innovative and creative self-starter.

· Interest in staff and organization development work.

jobs.title: Administrative Operations Coordinator, Associate
jobs.description:
### **Job Description:**

Bring your organizational skills, attention to detail, and interest in data and process improvement to FHLBank San Francisco.

As an Administrative Operations Coordinator supporting Credit and Collateral Risk Management (CCRM), you’ll help the department maintain accurate information, execute operational controls, and coordinate work across business and technology teams. Your responsibilities will combine advanced administrative support with reporting, process documentation, testing, and project coordination.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys working with data, keeping complex activities organized, and finding practical ways to improve how work gets done.

**What you’ll do**

  

* Support accurate data and reporting. Maintain departmental databases, business records, and customer profiles. Process membership and counterparty portfolio changes, reconcile information, and prepare recurring operational, credit agreement, control, and regulatory reports.
* Contribute to credit and collateral operations. Gather source data, maintain customer files, compile reporting inputs, and support analysts with risk monitoring, research distribution, and compliance activities.
* Document and improve processes. Maintain procedures, workflows, job aids, reporting tools, and process inventories. Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, strengthen controls, and reduce manual work for process-owner review.
* Support system and operational changes. Help gather and document business requirements, coordinate stakeholder follow-up, and support user acceptance testing by recording results, tracking defects, and coordinating resolution.
* Coordinate departmental business activities. Support vendor requests, purchase requisitions, disbursements, expense tracking, records retention, and business unit onboarding.
* Support leadership and committee operations. Schedule meetings, prepare management and committee materials, coordinate Credit Committee and Credit Review Working Group attendance, track action items, and prepare minutes for review.
* Handle sensitive information with care. Maintain appropriate controls over confidential business records and regulatory materials in accordance with Bank policies and procedures.

**What you’ll bring**

  

* Strong Microsoft Office skills, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and SharePoint or comparable collaboration tools.
* Strong Excel capabilities, including formulas, lookup functions, pivot tables, data validation, charts, and controlled spreadsheet design.
* Ability to compile, validate, reconcile, and analyze information from multiple sources, identify exceptions and trends, and communicate findings accurately.
* Ability to clearly document processes, controls, requirements, test scenarios, and implementation results.
* Working knowledge of data quality, reconciliation, exception management, process improvement, root-cause analysis, user acceptance testing, and change implementation.
* Strong organization, judgment, discretion, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and escalate issues appropriately.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to prepare accurate materials for leadership, committees, auditors, regulators, and other stakeholders.
* Knowledge of records management, confidentiality requirements, and administrative controls.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate across teams.
* Familiarity with Power Query, Power BI, SQL, Access, or comparable tools is preferred.

**Why FHLBank San Francisco**

Here, your expertise connects to a broader purpose. You’ll collaborate with skilled colleagues in an organization that values individual contributions and supports employees’ professional growth and work and life goals.

Our benefits support employees and their families, including:

  

* Work from anywhere in the U.S. for six weeks annually, including four individually selected weeks and two Bank designated weeks.
* Medical, dental, vision, and mental health support.
* A 401(k) with company match, life insurance, and disability coverage.
* Vacation, sick leave, holidays, wellness, and volunteer days.
* Backup care for children, elders, and pets, plus parental and family leave.
* Annual wellness and technology stipends, a transit subsidy, and pretax commuter benefits.

**Annual base salary:** $85,000–$95,000

The Federal Home Loan Bank of San Francisco is committed to the principles of equal opportunity in employment (e.g., employees, applicants) and in contracting (e.g., suppliers, vendors) regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a parent, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are committed to cultivating a workplace free of unlawful discrimination, harassment, and retaliation, and are dedicated to fostering vibrant communities by serving as a reliable source of liquidity and resources for affordable housing and economic development.

Salary ranges reflect the base salary that the Bank reasonably expects to pay for a given role and is not inclusive of annual incentive award opportunities, retirement benefits or the value of other health and welfare or other ancillary benefits. We consider many factors when determining base salaries such as individual background and experience, the competitive environment, education, particular skill set(s), and industry and institutional knowledge.

In support of this commitment, the Bank routinely engages in market competitive benchmarking surveys and analysis to ensure our team members continue to be paid fairly and competitively.

jobs.title: Events & Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
San Francisco · Full-time · In-person · Reports to CEO

**Pay range:** $110,000–$150,000 base salary, plus equity.

The final offer depends on experience and skills.

### **About Neon Blue**

Most product, pricing, and marketing decisions never get tested before the money is spent. Neon Blue builds grounded simulated audiences of a company's customers and market, built from real human studies, so teams can test those decisions first.

We're a seed-stage company in San Francisco, hiring our first events lead. This is a senior individual-contributor seat. You report to the CEO, you run the program yourself, and you are not managing a team. You own the dinners and events we host, and our presence at conferences.

### **What you'll own**

The dinners and events we host, plus conferences and other field programs — roughly 15 a year — built with our founding marketer as a peer. The invitation, the experience, and the follow-up are one system. You're measured on qualified conversations and opportunities, not badge scans.

* Build a roughly 15-event calendar of the dinners and events we host and selected conferences, tied to priority accounts and a clear budget.
* Own venues, vendors, sponsorships, shipping, and onsite execution.
* Work with the founding marketer, our CEO, and sales to book meetings before each event.
* Prepare speakers, staffing plans, and run-of-show documents.
* Coordinate lead capture and timely sales follow-up.
* Report cost per qualified meeting, pipeline, and lessons for the next event.

### **What you'll do in your first 90 days**

* Build the first-year calendar — roughly 15 events, including the dinners and events we host as well as conferences — with budget, owners, and a clear reason for each one.
* Lock the next wave of venues, vendors, and logistics.
* Run early dinners or events yourself, and tightly support conference presence with the founding marketer, including pre-booking and onsite execution.
* Stand up the follow-up motion so every event has a path to qualified meetings.
* Report on the first events: cost per qualified meeting, pipeline, and a point of view on what to repeat or drop.

### **You might be a fit if**

* You've independently delivered B2B field programs for several years, including a multi-event calendar and a budget, and you've run dinners or hosted events — not only conference booths.
* You're strong on vendors, logistics, and the unglamorous work that makes an event feel effortless.
* You've worked with sales on account targeting and follow-up, and you care about meetings and pipeline, not badge scans.
* You're based in San Francisco and can travel for events.
* You like building the program from zero, you do the work yourself, and you don't need a team under you to get it done.

### **Nice to have**

* Executive dinner and roundtable experience you ran end to end.
* You've turned events into useful content.

### **Why join**

You'll build our field motion from the ground up, including dinners and events we host ourselves. You'll report to the CEO, work in person in San Francisco with our founding marketer, and stay close to the product and the deals.

### **In-person in San Francisco**

This is a full-time role. We work in person in San Francisco. The role includes travel to conferences and field events.

### **Equal opportunity**

Neon Blue is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, and we provide reasonable accommodations in the hiring process on request. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation Range: $110K - $150K

jobs.description:
**About Bobyard**

Construction is a multi-trillion-dollar industry facing a shortage of roughly 349,000 workers — and it still estimates by hand. Contractors spend weeks measuring and counting materials off drawings, and that caps how many jobs they can bid. Bobyard’s AI takes a contractor from a set of plans to a bid in minutes instead of weeks. Our customers run real construction jobs on Bobyard, not demos. We raised a $35M Series A led by 8VC, with Primary and Pear.

**Who we are**

Builders. We ship real product to real contractors. If it doesn’t survive contact with a live job, it doesn’t count — we don’t do demo-ware.

Owners. There’s no layer between you and the problem, and no permission slip required. When you see the solution, you own it, end to end.

Independent minds. Strong convictions, open minds. We hire for how you think, not where you learned it — show us the work, not the résumé.

Fast movers. We decide quickly and optimize for impact, not consensus. You’ll be judged by the people in the problem with you, on what you deliver.

**About the role**

Our CSM team is growing faster than one leader can coach. You'll lead a pod of Customer Success Managers, own their retention and expansion numbers, and build the playbook the next pods will run on. You'll still take the hardest accounts yourself.

**What you'll do**

* Lead, coach, and hire a pod of CSMs, and set the bar for what good looks like
* Own your pod's gross and net revenue retention, and know where every account stands each week
* Spot stalling accounts early, and run the save plan yourself when it matters
* Drive renewals, upsells, and win-backs with your team
* Take customers from Implementation without a gap, and turn their feedback into product fixes with Product
* Build the coverage model, health signals, and dashboards that show where to hire and what to automate
* Jump on the hardest customer calls, from estimators to owners

**What we're looking for**

* 6+ years in B2B SaaS customer success or account management, with 2+ years leading CSMs
* You've managed hundreds of SMB or mid-market accounts, not a dozen whales
* You know your team's GRR, NRR, and churn cold, and can show what you personally moved
* Commercial instinct. You're comfortable owning renewal and expansion targets
* You coach in the details: call reviews, account plans, weekly numbers
* Comfortable training non-technical field users

**Nice to have**

* Construction, trades, or field-service software experience
* Built customer success operations on HubSpot and Intercom
* Scaled a CS team through a period of fast growth

**A note on pace**

We move fast, and priorities shift as we learn from customers. Playbooks, context, and requirements are often incomplete when work starts, and you'll be expected to shape them. If that pace excites you, you'll fit in well.

**What we offer**

Cash for stability. Bonus for performance. Equity for ownership. Your package reflects your role, your experience, and what you deliver, and it grows as you do.

* 170,000–190,000 base + bonus tied to retention and expansion + 0.03%–0.05% equity — pending HM confirmation
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4%
* Catered lunch in the office and $70 a month toward your commute
* Full-time, in person at our San Francisco office (101 2nd Street), 4 days a week.

Come build with us!

Compensation Range: $170K - $190K

jobs.title: Operations & Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Corvus**
----------------

We’re Corvus Robotics, a Physical AI company transforming how the world’s warehouses operate. By combining autonomous robotics, computer vision, and AI, we’re replacing manual, labor-intensive processes with intelligent systems that make inventory management safer, smarter, and more efficient.

Our flagship Corvus One drones autonomously track warehouse inventory around the clock, while Corvus Trident, our AI-powered forklift intelligence system, captures inventory movement in real time. Together, our technologies provide a complete picture of warehouse operations, helping enterprises improve accuracy, efficiency, and decision-making.

Our technology is widely deployed and delivering value for leading enterprises. We’re now building a future where warehouse operations are fully autonomous. At Corvus, you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, solve challenging real-world problems, and help bring the next generation of intelligent robots to scale.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a highly organized, resourceful, and hands-on Operations & Logistics Coordinator to support our growing robotics manufacturing operations.

You'll help keep our production and shipping operations running smoothly by managing inventory, coordinating purchasing, tracking incoming materials, and ensuring finished hardware reaches customers on time.

This is not a traditional desk-based logistics role. You'll be actively involved in day-to-day operations, working closely with manufacturing technicians, engineers, and vendors while managing both administrative and physical tasks.

The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys solving operational problems, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is equally comfortable managing purchase orders, organizing inventory, and preparing shipments.

This is a fully onsite role at our Mountain View headquarters, five days a week.

**What You'll Do**

* Manage day-to-day inventory operations, including receiving, organizing, tracking, and maintaining hardware components and supplies.
* Create, track, and manage purchase orders for manufacturing materials, tools, and equipment.
* Coordinate with vendors and suppliers to ensure timely delivery of parts and materials.
* Monitor inventory levels, identify shortages, and support procurement planning.
* Organize and maintain warehouse, storage, and manufacturing areas.
* Coordinate incoming and outgoing shipments, including packaging, labeling, documentation, and carrier scheduling.
* Work closely with manufacturing technicians and quality engineers to ensure materials and finished products are available when needed.
* Maintain accurate inventory records and update internal tracking systems.
* Assist with packing crates, preparing customer shipments, and safely moving hardware and equipment.
* Track shipping deadlines, resolve logistics issues, and communicate updates across teams.
* Support general office and operational needs as required.
* Identify opportunities to improve purchasing, inventory accuracy, shipping workflows, and operational efficiency.

**What We're Looking For**

* Experience in operations, logistics, inventory management, purchasing, shipping, or a related coordination role.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Experience managing multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfortable working with inventory tracking systems, spreadsheets, and operational software.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams.
* Willingness to handle both administrative responsibilities and hands-on physical tasks.
* Ability to safely lift, move, and organize boxes, equipment, and materials, with or without reasonable accommodation.
* Resourceful, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of day-to-day operational challenges.
* Ability to work onsite in Mountain View five days per week.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in robotics, hardware manufacturing, or startup operations.
* Familiarity with purchasing, inventory management, ERP systems, and shipping logistics.
* Experience coordinating warehouse operations and production workflows.
* Background in administrative or office operations with hands-on logistics experience.
* Familiarity with AI tools and process automation.

**Why Join Corvus Robotics?**

**Build technology that works in the real world.** Be part of a team bringing autonomous robotics and AI into real-world environments, solving meaningful challenges and transforming warehouse operations.

**Own your impact.** Take ownership of meaningful work, contribute to important decisions, and see the direct impact of your contributions as we grow.

**Help scale the next generation of Physical AI.** Join at a pivotal stage of growth and help build the technology, teams, systems, and processes that will bring autonomous robotics to enterprise scale.

**Grow alongside the company.** Work with talented, driven people across disciplines, tackle new challenges, expand your skills, and help shape the future of Corvus Robotics.

Compensation Range: $70K - $90K

The GME (Graduate Medical Education) Program Coordinator will be responsible for coordinating and managing the administrative and operational activities associated with medical education programs at MSKCC.

The individual will support the onboarding, credentialing, documentation, and ongoing administration of residents, fellows, medical students, and visiting observers.

This position requires someone with strong administrative and organizational skills and familiarity with a hospital or healthcare environment.

The coordinator will work closely with GME Administration, HR, internal hospital departments, external institutions, and medical education applicants to ensure that all onboarding and compliance requirements are completed accurately and on time.

**In simple terms:** This is a healthcare administrative coordination role focused on managing the onboarding and documentation of medical residents, fellows, students, and observers.

**2. Key Responsibilities**
---------------------------

### **A. Program Operations & Coordination**

* Review and evaluate approximately 500 observer applications annually.
* Determine applicant eligibility based on established checklists and program requirements.
* Respond to inquiries from prospective applicants regarding application procedures and eligibility.
* Coordinate onboarding for medical students, observers, residents, and fellows.
* Arrange orientation, housing, paperwork, training programs, and access to hospital systems.
* Coordinate with other hospitals, universities, and external institutions for applicant onboarding.
* Ensure all applicants complete the necessary documentation and onboarding formalities.

### **B. Administrative Support**

* Track applicant onboarding progress through the HR Applicant Tracking System.
* Enter and maintain information in the GME credentialing database.
* Prepare registration materials for incoming residents, fellows, medical students, and observers.
* Maintain electronic and physical records, files, correspondence, and documentation.
* Prepare and distribute appointment and reappointment packages.
* Scan, index, and organize affiliation agreements and other institutional documents.
* Monitor the status of institutional affiliation agreements.
* Coordinate logistics for orientations, educational lectures, meetings, and departmental events.
* Manage front-office responsibilities, including phone calls and general inquiries.

### **C. Database & Information Management**

* Maintain databases containing applicant paperwork, credentials, and onboarding information.
* Provide documentation and status updates to the GME Credentials Coordinator.
* Maintain institutional affiliation agreement records.
* Manage and navigate various hospital and administrative systems, including:CONNECTiCIMSAuricoNew InnovationsNYS Health Commerce System
* Manage Health Commerce account activations for approximately 800 house staff members annually.

### **D. Compliance & Documentation**

* Maintain credentialing records in accordance with New York State medical staff standards.
* Ensure observer documentation and policies are followed.
* Support compliance with New York State Department of Health (DOH) and Department of Education (DOE) regulations.
* Ensure all required onboarding and credentialing documentation is complete and properly maintained.
* Handle confidential employee, student, and medical education records appropriately.

The Residence Program Specialist provides direct support, skill-building, and advocacy to ensure that the people we support achieve their personal goals and enjoy the highest quality of life possible.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

The duties and responsibilities of the Residential Program Specialist will include, but are not limited to the following:

* Provides care and supports the people we support in achieving greater independence and personal development.
* Ensures the safety, health, and well-being of the people we support at all times.
* Teaches and assists with activities of daily living (ADLs), including self-help, social, and community living skills.
* Maintains a personalized, homelike, and respectful atmosphere within the residence.
* Participates actively in interdisciplinary treatment plans and implements individualized program goals.
* Documents daily activities, progress notes, incident reports, and other required records accurately and in a timely manner.
* Responds to crisis situations and medical emergencies, including providing first aid and contacting emergency personnel as needed.
* Contacts emergency personnel (police, fire, ambulance) when necessary to ensure safety of the people we support and staff.
* Ensures all actions are conducted in a manner that prevents abuse, neglect, or exploitation, and immediately reports any concerns in accordance with agency policy.
* Follows all OPWDD-approved behavior management guidelines, including use of approved interventions when required.
* Administers medications as an Approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP), following agency protocols and under nursing supervision.
* Provides transportation for the people we support to program, work, appointments, and recreational activities as needed.
* Assists with meal planning, grocery shopping, and meal preparation to promote nutrition and independence.
* Participates in housekeeping, laundry, and light maintenance tasks to ensure a safe, clean, and supportive environment.
* Attends and participates in staff meetings, trainings, and in-service sessions to support ongoing development and quality care.
* Promotes dignity, respect, and person-centered approaches in all interactions with the people we support, families, and staff.
* Maintains confidentiality of all resident information and documentation.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Six months of related experience is preferred but not required.
* Employees must be approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP) at time of hire or within six months of date of hire.
* Valid New York State Driver’s License, maintained in good standing
* Ability to read, write, speak and understand English.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills for working effectively with the people we support, families, coworkers, and community partners.
* Ability to respond appropriately to crisis situations and make sound decisions under pressure.
* Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and safeguarding the rights of the people we support.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

**COMPENSATION:** $20.17/hour (after probation) + Industry-Leading Benefits for all full-time employees.

**At ADAPT, we value diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, and belonging.** We strive to ensure that our employees are comfortable bringing their whole, authentic self to work and that the people we support can also be their authentic selves. We value diverse backgrounds, opinions, ideas, and ways of thinking. We aim to build an inclusive and diverse workforce that is empowered and supported with leaders who create diverse and inclusive teams. We continuously seek opportunities for the organization to foster a more positive, respected, united, and collaborative culture.

ADAPT Community Network is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Qualified candidates of diverse ethnic and racial backgrounds and status are encouraged to apply for vacant positions at all levels.

jobs.title: Studio Manager/ Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
Taylor Corporation is a dynamic, diversified company with big plans for the future ― and your career. We power our employees’ potential and strive to create opportunity and security for every member of the team. If you’re ready for something bigger ― more challenge, more variety, more pathways for professional growth ― we should talk. We’re passionate about our work, we believe there is always a better way, and we’re looking for people like you.
  
  
Ready to reach your potential? It’s time to look at Taylor.
  
  
**Your Opportunity:** OTHRWRLD, a subsidiary of Taylor, is an award-winning creative production studio producing high-impact music video, fashion, beauty, and entertainment content, branded documentary storytelling, and original film. We partner with artists, brands, agencies, and cultural institutions to create visually ambitious work rooted in real human stories.

  

We’re growing — and we’re looking for a hybrid **Studio Manager / Junior Production Coordinator** to work directly alongside our EP and production team across studio operations and production. A dual-function position sitting at the intersection of studio operations and production support. You’ll keep the studio running while getting hands-on experience across the full production cycle. The balance shifts week to week — some weeks are operations-heavy, others involve full shoot days.

**Work Authorization:** To be considered for the Taylor opportunities, candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship.

  

**Your Responsibilities:**

*As a Studio Manager:*

* Own day-to-day studio operations: scheduling, supplies, vendor relationships, equipment tracking
* Manage inbound project inquiries and maintain the studio calendar
* Coordinate with talent, freelancers, and external creatives on logistics
* Keep internal systems (files, drives, templates, contacts) organized and current
Support invoicing, purchase orders, and basic production accounting  

  

*As a Jr. Production Coordinator:*

* Assist Producers and EPs on active music video and editorial productions
* Build and maintain call sheets, crew lists, and production schedules
* Track deliverables and deadlines across concurrent projects
* Liaise between departments (creative, post, talent management) to keep communication clean
* Research locations, vendors, and casting options as needed
* Collect, compile, and organize all production receipts, invoices, and expense documentation throughout the project lifecycle
* Prepare and process subcontractor agreements, deal memos, and crew contracts
* Manage job wraps end-to-end: final cost reports, closing POs, ensuring all paperwork is accounted for and filed
Maintain organized production drives with clearly structured folders for each project — contracts, budgets, receipts, deliverables  

  

**Skills You'll Bring:**

* 1–3 years in a production, studio, or creative agency environment
* Fluent in Google Workspace, Frame.io, and project management tools (Notion, Airtable, etc.)
* Calm under pressure, detail-obsessed, and not precious about wearing multiple hats
* Familiar with the music video / commercial production world — you know what a one-liner is
* Strong written communication — able to draft professional correspondence and contracts
NYC-based and available for on-set days when needed  

*The anticipated annual salary range for this position is $70,000-$80,000. The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, which may include as applicable, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job. The range listed is just one component of Taylor Corporation’s total compensation and benefits package for employees.*  
  
**About Taylor Corporation**  
One of the largest print and communications firms in North America, Taylor’s family of companies provides a diverse set of products, services and technologies that address the toughest business challenges. We work diligently each day to create printed and digital marketing communication solutions that help power many of the world’s most recognizable brands.
  
  
With more than 50 years of category expertise and 10,000 employees spanning dozens of U.S. states and multiple countries, Taylor serves businesses and distributors both large and small. Our employees enjoy a comprehensive benefit package including a choice of several health plans, dental, vision, wellness programs, life and disability coverage, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, a 401(k) plan with company match, paid time off (PTO) and 64 hours of annual holiday pay.
  
  
***The Employer retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position.***

  

***Taylor Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.***

Taylor Corporation including all partners and affiliates is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled.

jobs.description:
**Temporary Administrative Coordinator**

An opportunity has arisen for an outstanding **Temporary Administrative Coordinator** to provide complete administrative support to a few teams and leaders in our hybrid work environment based in our New York City office. This temporary role is anticipated to last between 3-6 months.

Though you’ll have a defined group of employees you’re supporting, the strength of our team is that we are well-connected to share our workloads, cover each other’s vacations, and work together to adapt to new workflows as the US region grows. (Emphasis on covering each other’s vacations – that includes you unplugging and forgetting us when you’re off the clock!)

Working amongst a team of dedicated, enthusiastic, and creative administrative professionals, this role will see you work as a team to keep loose ends tied up, which allows our technical teams to focus on their specialties. When our newest museum or net zero energy building opens up, you’ll know that you had a role in bringing that project to life.

**Here at Buro Happold, Expect the Exceptional.**

From the projects you will work on to the clients we work with. From career-defining opportunities to an inclusive and diverse practice where we all contribute to a more equitable world. From our reputation to our relationships. Wherever your Buro Happold career takes you, it'll be anything but ordinary.

**Your next role**

Join us and be surrounded by exceptional opportunities in an environment alive with innovation and possibility. Your new team has a willingness and curiosity to see possibility and potential in everything – from the most iconic projects to our everyday conversations. In this role, you’ll provide all-around administrative support to defined employee teams and key employees while working collaboratively with our broader administrative team. You’ll help keep day-to-day activities organized and running smoothly, allowing our technical teams to focus on delivering exceptional work for our clients.

**Your key duties**

* Provide all-around administrative support to 1–2 defined employee teams and/or 1–3 key employees. Tasks vary and may include preparing reports, logging and responding to project-related inquiries, formatting large batches of documents, renewing memberships, and coordinating meetings as needed.
* Provide back-up support to other administrative professionals and their teams while they are out, with the same support provided to you when you are away.
* Manage and coordinate business travel arrangements.
* Provide light facilities back-up when needed.
* Perform other administrative duties as assigned.

**Your skills and experience**

* Experience working in a highly detailed field or industry, with 1–2 years of experience in a support role.
* A positive attitude and enthusiasm for connecting with the team and their work, along with an eagerness to get to know employees across disciplines and work collaboratively.
* Great communication skills across email, instant messaging, in-person interactions, video meetings, and phone calls. (During business hours – we don’t want to hear from you on your vacation!)
* Strong computer skills and experience using spreadsheets and databases within the Microsoft suite. If you aren’t already highly skilled in Microsoft products, we also welcome experience successfully learning a variety of new software and programs.
* Experience in one or more of the following areas: administrative or office work, travel arrangements, personal assistance, event planning, or other detail-oriented, people-facing positions.
* We encourage candidates to apply even if their experience does not align perfectly with every qualification listed.

**What we offer**

* Hybrid working environment
* Connection to a global network of experts at the forefront of industry initiatives
* Access to wide-ranging learning and development opportunities
* Connect with colleagues and build your network through our Employee Resource Groups, including the Young Employees Forum and Diversity & Inclusion Forum

**Compensation**

Anticipated hourly pay: $30.00 – $32.00. The compensation range listed for this position is intended as a general guideline and may vary based on factors such as geographic location, education, skills, experience, and market conditions. We recognize that candidates bring diverse backgrounds and qualifications, and compensation may be adjusted accordingly. The posted range should not be viewed as a strict minimum or maximum limitation. Benefits and any additional compensation elements are separate from the base salary range listed.

Apply now to start your career journey with us.

**A place for everyone**

Buro Happold values an individual's flexible approaches to working patterns as an important part of how you work and achieve balance. We welcome applications from those who are seeking flexibility in their careers.

The Community Outreach & Recruitment Specialist identifies and develops community referral sources, conducts recruitment of clients for the ADHC, and coordinates timely intake and admission to the Adult Day Health Care (ADHC) program. The Specialist maintains an active referral pipeline, supports supervision of Peer Outreach Workers, and monitors new client engagement and retention during the first 90 days of enrollment.

Essential Job Functions

* Establishes and maintains referral accounts and relationships with hospitals, healthcare providers, senior centers, community organizations, social service agencies, and other appropriate sources; visits established accounts at least monthly to sustain a consistent pipeline of qualified prospective clients.
