jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY  
The Bernikow JCC Staten Island’s Career Service’s department helps individuals prepare for and secure long-term employment through career counseling, job placement assistance, occupational training, education, and supportive services.  
  
ABOUT YOU  
You will connect residents to Career Services programs and help new participants get ready to start. The coordinator builds relationships with community partners, leads information sessions, guides participants through intake and enrollment, and facilitates orientation. The coordinator serves as the primary point of contact from initial inquiry through orientation and works with Career Services staff and training partners to ensure participants know what to expect, where to report, and whom to contact for support.  
  
WHAT YOU’LL DO  
**Community Outreach and Participant Engagement**

* Develop and carry out outreach plans to connect Staten Island residents with Career Services programs, including individuals who face barriers to employment or training.
* Build and maintain referral relationships with schools, community-based organizations, workforce providers, and other local partners. Share program information, eligibility criteria and enrollment timelines.
* Represent Career Services at community events, career fairs, open houses, and partner meetings. Lead in-person and virtual information sessions for prospective participants.
* Respond to inquiries by phone, email and in-person. Explain available programs, eligibility requirements and next steps in clear, accessible language.
* Track outreach activities, inquires, referrals and enrollment by referral source. Use the results to identify which outreach efforts are reaching prospective participants.

**Participant Onboarding**

* Guide incoming participants through intake forms, required documentation, eligibility verification and other steps needed before their program begins
* Maintain accurate and confidential participant records. Track outstanding requirements and follow up with participants before enrollment deadlines.
* Identify barriers that could delay a participant’s start, such as missing documents, transportation needs or technology access. Connect participants with appropriate staff or resources for assistance.

**Orientation and Program Transition**

* Plan and facilitate accessible in-person and virtual orientations for new participants. Revie program schedules, attendance and participation expectations, available supports and key contacts.
* Prepare and update welcome packets, orientation presentations, checklists and resource guides. Coordinate facility tours or virtual platform walkthroughs as needed.
* Track orientation attendance and completion. Follow up with participants who miss orientation or need help preparing for their first day.
* Gather participant feedback and use it to improve orientation materials, delivery and follow-up.

  
OUR REQUIREMENTS

* Bachelor’s degree in education, communication, public relations, human services, social work, business administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* At least one year of experience in community outreach, participant recruitment, enrollment, program coordination, workforce development or a related area.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to facilitate group sessions in person and online and explain program requirements clearly.
* Ability to build relationships with community partners and work respectfully with participants from varied backgrounds.
* Strong organization skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and maintain accurate records.

  
PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and spreadsheets. Experience with participant databases, case management systems, or enrollment platforms a plus.
* Ability to safeguard confidential information and follow program documentation and eligibility requirements.
* Availability to work occasional evenings or weekends for outreach events and orientations.

  
SALARY  
$50,000- $55,000 Annually, depending on experience and qualifications.
  
  
BENEFITS  
The JCC of Staten Island is committed to keeping you and your family healthy and happy through a comprehensive benefits program. Offerings include: subsidized options for Medical; offerings for Dental and Vision coverage, FSA and Dependent Care. We also offer free LTD, STD, Life Insurance, a Pension, 403B, generous program discounts, free membership, ample time off and much more!  
  
ABOUT US  
The Jewish Community Center of Staten Island was founded in 1929 with the goal of creating a home for the Jewish community by offering social, recreational, and educational activities. Over time, that mission expanded to help anyone who walked through the doors of any of our facilities. The JCC has become a true community center—not just for the Jewish community, but for the entirety of Staten Island.
  
  
Programs serve the needs we see in our community and are constantly expanding to meet new demand. We serve people of all walks of life, from young children to seniors and everyone in between. The JCC is proud to offer services that help improve the quality of life for people on Staten Island and beyond. We strive to help those in need as well as provide recreational and educational opportunities for our members.  
The JCC of Staten Island is dedicated to encouraging harmony throughout the community by providing facilities and programs that are open to all regardless of race, religion, creed, color, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or political affiliation. Everyone is welcome at the JCC.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Location**
------------

New York

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Department**
--------------

GTM DepartmentMarketing

**Compensation**
----------------

* $230K – $350K • Offers Equity

  

**About Us:** 
**AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.

  

Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.

We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation.

Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn,Luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.

**The Role**
------------

This is a commercial role with a revenue target. You’ll be measured on retention and expansion across your accounts. While you won’t be delivering the technical recommendations and implementation, the work is technical by nature. Our customers are engineers running GPU workloads, inference, and batch jobs in production, and you’ll be a credible partner in those conversations.

The profile we’re hiring is a technical account manager. You’ve worked at companies that are deeply technical and consumption in nature. You bring the commercial instincts to grow revenue from an existing base and enough technical depth to know which conversation actually matters. And you can work credibly with everyone from a CxO to a Developer.

*What the role is*

* An early seat. You’re helping build the AM function with us, not joining one that already runs. The account plans, expansion motions, and customer cadence this team figures out are what we scale to every AM we hire after you
* A technical customer-facing role. You’ll work directly with Developers and ML teams on what they’re building and how Modal fits. You translate and triage the deeper technical work to FDEs and Product when it’s needed
* A book of business. You’ll own a set of accounts and be responsible for the revenue that comes from them. Expect to be meeting with customers in your first few days because the best playbooks are built from real experiences

*What the role is not*

* A traditional post-sales role. You’re measured on revenue, not health scores
* An on-call support function. You’re not fixing bugs or triaging tickets. You’re growing accounts
* A technical delivery role. You’re not implementing for the customer. You know where the technical work goes and you pull in the right people
* A fully built motion. Much of this is still being built. If you spot gaps in process, tooling, or a playbook, you help build them
* A single-lane job. Our priorities go customer company team self. We focus on delivering maximum impact vs. “this is my job”

**What You’ll Work On:**
------------------------

* Build Modal’s account management function and iterate on it as we scale the business
* Own and deliver on a revenue target across your book of accounts
* Grow an account’s first use case, expand into a second, and drive standardization across the Modal platform
* Get fluent enough in Modal to engage confidently with engineering teams on their workloads, and know when to pull in FDEs, Support, or Product
* Work with Sales, Solutions Architects, FDEs, Support, and Product to grow accounts and feed customer signal back into the roadmap
* Travel to customers as needed to support key accounts and find expansion opportunities

**You May Be a Fit If:**
------------------------

* You’ve owned a revenue target or supported one in a highly technical, consumption business.
* You work autonomously with Developers through CxOs and understand the core parts of the developer tech stack.
* You’re hands on building with AI tools, not just consuming workflows that were built for you.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

Riskified empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by taking risk off the table. Many of the world's biggest brands and publicly traded companies selling online rely on Riskified for guaranteed protection against chargebacks, to fight fraud and policy abuse at scale, and to improve customer retention. Developed and managed by the largest team of ecommerce risk analysts, data scientists and researchers, Riskified's AI-powered fraud and risk intelligence platform analyzes the individual behind each interaction to provide real-time decisions and robust identity-based insights. Riskified is proud to work with incredible companies in virtually all industries including Acer, Gucci, Lorna Jane, GoPro, and many more.

We thrive in a collaborative work setting, alongside great people, to build and enhance products that matter. Abundant opportunities to create and contribute provide us with a sense of purpose that extends beyond ourselves, leaving a lasting impact. These sentiments capture why we choose Riskified every day.

**About the Role**
------------------

At Riskified, we succeed when our merchants succeed. As such, you'll be the merchant's representative within Riskified, helping them to maximize the value they receive from our service. You will be expected to manage and prioritize their needs to ensure they're happy and profitable. Your clients will include Fortune 500 companies, big-box retailers, startups, travel merchants, and more. You'll collaborate daily with various Riskified teams, including Product, Analytics, Data Science and Development.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

* Own a portfolio of merchants as their primary point of contact, from onboarding through renewal and expansion
* Monitor portfolio health at scale (approval rates, chargeback rates, SLA performance and order volume) using dashboards and AI tools, and act on risks and opportunities before merchants raise them
* Build and run AI-powered workflows for account research, business review prep, follow-ups and routine merchant questions, then share what works so the whole team benefits
* Design repeatable, one-to-many programs, such as automated health check-ins, templated business reviews, webinars and lifecycle campaigns, so every merchant gets consistent value
* Decide which tasks should be automated and which deserve a person's time, and go deeper with the merchants who have the most growth potential or risk
* Use usage and performance data to prioritize your book, and identify and lead upsell and cross-sell opportunities
* Onboard new merchants quickly through a standardized, scalable process
* Work with Product, Analytics, Data Science and Development to turn patterns across your portfolio into product feedback and process improvements

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 2–4+ years of experience in a client-facing role such as account management or customer success, ideally managing a large portfolio of mid-market or SMB customers
* You use AI tools in your daily work today, and can show a workflow you built that gave you real time back
* Hands-on experience building automations (CRM workflows, no-code tools, scripts or AI agents); SQL is a plus
* Strong analytical skills, including the ability to identify salient data from multiple sources and use it to prioritize a large book
* Ability to interpret and present complex data clearly and concisely
* Superb writing and communication skills
* Highly organized and structured, and comfortable managing many accounts at once in a fast-paced environment
* Problem-solver, resourceful and independent; you'd see automating part of your own role as a win
* Great interpersonal skills and a team player
* eCommerce/FinTech background and/or experience working in a fast-growth B2B SaaS setting is strongly preferred
* Bachelor's degree - preferably in a highly quantitative field

  

This is an incentive-based role and a significant portion of compensation is based on performance against objectives. The OTE range for this position is $187,000- 204,000. This range is applicable to candidates who will perform the job either wholly, or in part, within New York City. Actual salary will be based on qualifications, competencies, and location. If you feel this range is not attractive, we encourage you to let us know through the application process.

Base salary is just one part of the pay package at Riskified. All full-time regular employees receive a bonus target and are eligible to receive stock-based awards. Also, our value proposition goes way beyond compensation: our perks and benefits package, culture, community, and learning and development programs are just some of the elements we provide to bring value to our employees. We invite you to apply at www.riskified.com to learn more about what we have to offer.

  

**Life at Riskified**
---------------------

We are a fast-growing and dynamic tech company with 750+ team members globally. We value collaboration and innovative thinking. We're looking for bright, driven, and passionate people to grow with us.

Some of our NYC Benefits & Perks:

* Our NYC team is currently working in a hybrid of remote and in-office for all our team members
* Fully-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance from your first day
* Equity for all employees, 401(k) + matching, commuter benefits
* Catered lunch, fully-stocked kitchen, team events, happy hours, birthday celebrations
* Yoga, pilates, soccer league, wellness classes
* Wide-ranging opportunities to volunteer and make an impact in local communities
* Commitment to your professional development with global onboarding, sales bootcamp, skills-based courses, full access to Udemy, lunch & learns

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About Juicebox**

Juicebox is on a mission to help teams **win the talent war**.

In the age of AI, human ingenuity is the ultimate scarce resource. Recruiting is a zero-sum game where you either compete or lose.

Teams at Ramp, Notion, and leading AI labs use Juicebox to power their hiring, alongside **5,000+** customers from early-stage startups to Fortune 500 companies.

We are on the path to $100M in ARR **with 20%+ monthly growth**, powering thousands of searches every day and making Juicebox one of the fastest-growing AI SaaS companies in the world.

Juicebox has raised over **$116M** in funding from lead investors including Sequoia Capital, DST Global, and NFDG. Read more about our $80M Series B here. Additional investors in Juicebox include Y Combinator, Coatue, Bond, Lux, Verified Capital, and Committed Capital.

**About the Role**

Customer Success at Juicebox sits at the intersection of commercial ownership, AI workflow enablement, and customer strategy. CSMs own the full customer relationship—from onboarding and adoption to expansion and renewal—while serving as trusted advisors and AI workflow experts.

Our customers range from enterprise talent teams to startup founders, staffing firms, and VC talent partners. As a PLG business, customers start small and scale quickly, so you'll often be managing onboarding, expansion, and renewal motions simultaneously.

You'll help define what Customer Success looks like in an AI-first world at a hypergrowth company shaping a new category. Our customers love the product, embrace innovation, and genuinely enjoy partnering with us. You'll do it alongside a low-ego, collaborative team and work directly with a VP of CS who has built world-class organizations at Gong, Slack, and Zendesk.

**You Will…**

* Own a portfolio of customers and drive measurable outcomes across onboarding, adoption, expansion, and renewal.
* Lead customer success plans, align on key metrics, and ensure talent leaders realize value quickly.
* Drive adoption of AI-native workflows, guide change management, and help customers reach their first “aha” moment and beyond.
* Own commercial conversations, including renewals, pricing negotiations, and complex buying processes.
* Identify and close expansion opportunities across teams, stakeholders, and product offerings.
* Build trusted, multi-threaded relationships with end users, champions, TA Ops leaders, and hiring managers.
* Lead ROI discussions and QBRs that demonstrate impact and strengthen partnerships.
* Help define and improve the Customer Success playbook by identifying gaps, solving problems, and scaling best practices.
* Live or be willing to relocate to New York City

**You Have…**

* 3+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Sales with ownership of a revenue target and a portfolio of 75-150 accounts.
* A track record of exceeding commercial goals and driving customer growth.
* The ability to manage multiple customer conversations and priorities simultaneously.
* A builder mindset and comfort operating in ambiguity before a playbook exists.
* Executive presence and confidence engaging senior stakeholders.
* Experience in SaaS, consulting, HR tech, or talent tech; recruiting industry experience is a plus, not a requirement.

**Perks & Benefits for all Full Time Employees**

* **Top-of-market compensation** with meaningful equity, because everyone should share in our success.
* **Daily meals provided:** breakfast catering, lunch order via DoorDash corporate, and for those who like to work late, dinner if staying after 7pm

**For US Employees:**

* **Comprehensive healthcare** with 100% employer-paid medical coverage for employees (PPO Platinum plan with $0 deductible). 90% employer contribution for dependents. Dental & Vision: 90% employer covered; 85% for dependents.
* **$2,000 annual wellness stipend** to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being.
* **$300/month commuting stipend** to help cover the cost of getting to and from the office.

**For UK Employees:**

* **Comprehensive private medical insurance** with £0 excess, full outpatient cover, comprehensive cancer care, mental health treatment, and 24/7 GP access.
* **£1,500 annual wellness stipend** to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being
* **£3,500/year commuting stipend** to help cover the cost of getting to and from the office.

Compensation Range: $165K - $230K

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Strategic
jobs.description:
**About Ramp**
==============

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the team and role**
---------------------------

Ramp’s Strategic Lifecycle Success team helps our largest and most complex customers turn their investment in Ramp into lasting business impact. After initial onboarding and implementation are complete, we help customers deepen adoption, continuously improve their Ramp setup, and successfully launch and activate additional products as their needs evolve.

As a Strategic Lifecycle Customer Success Manager, you’ll be a hands-on product expert and trusted partner to the finance, accounting, and operations teams using Ramp. You’ll own the ongoing customer success plan, proactively improve workflows, and lead onboarding and implementation when existing customers adopt new Ramp products. You’ll also lead adoption and value-focused business reviews, connecting how customers use Ramp to the outcomes that matter to their business.

You’ll work alongside an Account Manager, who owns commercial strategy and executive relationships, and partner with Solutions Consultants and Technical Consultants on complex technical needs. Your focus is helping customers get more from Ramp over time—from optimizing what’s already live to making each new product rollout successful.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* **Own ongoing success planning for a portfolio of customers.** After a structured handoff from initial onboarding and implementation, partner with a dedicated Account Manager to align on customer goals and define clear milestones, owners, and measures of success.
* **Serve as a trusted Ramp product expert.** Stay current on new products, capabilities, and best practices, and proactively translate relevant releases into recommendations for each customer.
* **Continuously enhance customers’ Ramp environments.** Understand their configuration and business processes, identify opportunities to improve policies, controls, approval flows, and workflows, and work hands-on with customers to put those improvements into practice.
* **Lead new-product implementations for existing customers.** Own discovery, planning, configuration, training, launch, and sustained adoption, aligning customer goals, owners, and milestones. Lead standard workflow improvements; partner with Solutions Consultants on complex design and validation, Technical Consultants on integrations, APIs, ERP connections, and data flows, and Support on troubleshooting and defect escalation. Specialists own diagnosis and execution; you own customer communication, cross-functional follow-through, and validation of outcomes.
* **Lead adoption and value-focused business reviews.** Define success measures and establish baselines with customers, then track improvements in adoption, spend consolidation, operational efficiency, and controls to demonstrate the value of their Ramp investment. Run regular adoption reviews with day-to-day stakeholders and partner with the Account Manager on executive QBRs and EBRs. Bring in the Account Manager or Solutions Consultant when useful, and coordinate joint reviews for Tier 1 accounts. Use evidence of progress to agree on next priorities.
* **Build customer champions and drive change.** Develop a network of champions across finance, accounting, AP, operations, and business units. Create enablement and change-management plans, including train-the-trainer approaches where useful, that equip customer teams to adopt new capabilities and sustain new ways of working beyond individual stakeholders.
* **Manage customer health proactively.** Monitor adoption, engagement, outcomes, and delivery risks; identify barriers early; and lead action plans to improve customer health. Equip your Account Manager with value evidence for renewal and growth conversations.
* **Identify customer success qualified leads (CSQLs).** Recognize growth signals through customer relationships, product usage, and evolving business needs, and qualify and proactively surface expansion opportunities to your Account Manager with clear customer context, value evidence, and recommended next steps. The Account Manager owns commercial strategy and execution.
* **Shape a repeatable lifecycle success motion.** Partner with Solutions Consultants, Technical Consultants, Support, and Product to resolve blockers and build playbooks for ongoing optimization and new-product activation. Translate recurring customer needs and workflow gaps into actionable feedback for Product, and close the loop with customers on relevant developments without making unconfirmed roadmap commitments.

**What you need**

BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.

BitGo is seeking an Associate Customer Success Manager to support our Start up/Growth client segment, working with a high volume of clients introduced through our Sales organization. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving problems, building client relationships, and delivering responsive, high-quality service in a fast-paced environment.

Unlike Senior Customer Success roles focused on managing a smaller portfolio of strategic & enterprise accounts, this position will emphasize efficient management of a broad client base, providing proactive and reactive client support, and issue resolution. You will partner closely with Sales, Support, Operations, and other internal teams to help clients navigate BitGo's products and services, resolve challenges, and get the most value from their relationship with BitGo.

This role also offers a defined opportunity for career growth, with the potential to progress into a Customer Success Manager position managing a smaller portfolio of dedicated clients as you develop deeper product expertise and demonstrate strong client ownership.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Client Relationship Management**

* Manage a high-volume portfolio of Start up/Growth clients, serving as a primary point of contact for day-to-day questions, requests, and follow-ups.

* Build strong working relationships with clients while maintaining consistent communication and a positive client experience.
* Help clients understand BitGo's products, services, workflows, and available resources.

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Sales to support clients following onboarding and initial commercial engagement, ensuring a smooth transition into ongoing client management.

### **Operational Excellence**

* Manage a high volume of client requests while prioritizing effectively and maintaining a high standard of service.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

We're a Leuven-based scale-up with a product that developers and product teams genuinely love, an ambitious international team, and real traction with customers ranging from Series B SaaS companies to Fortune 500 enterprises.

Our Brooklyn office at 77 Sands Street is where Luzmo's US story is being built. As our NY SDR, you'll be one of the first people shaping how we grow in North America.

### **The role**

This is a predominantly phone-based outbound role focused on creating qualified pipeline for our US Account Executives. You'll spend a meaningful part of your day speaking with prospective customers, qualifying opportunities, and opening doors.

You won't be working from cold lists alone. Our outbound motion is supported by a marketing and data engine that surfaces intent signals and high-potential accounts. Your job is to turn that intelligence into real conversations.

Beyond execution, we want someone who helps shape how outbound is done at Luzmo — testing messaging, improving targeting, and feeding insights back to the team.

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
GoodEarth Distribution is a national distributor of operational and facilities supplies. We excel in nationwide logistics, cost-effective solutions, and sustainability. A true "One-Stop-Shop" for all supply needs with greater than 100,000+ products in our portfolio. Product categories include cleaning and maintenance, office products and furniture, safety, packaging, personal care amenities, towels, laundry, and much more – all supported by a technologically advanced, web-based ordering platform that simplifies the procurement process.

\*\*\*Facility / Business Supplies and/or Distribution Industry Experience Preferred\*\*\*

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES: We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Logistics Coordinator to oversee our daily supply chain and distribution operations. In this role, you will serve as the central hub for our logistics pipeline, ensuring seamless freight booking and routing while managing the end-to-end freight claims process for cost recovery. You will be directly responsible for maintaining our master delivery tracker to provide real-time updates to key customer groups, monitoring outbound order fulfillment across 3PL warehouses, and collaborating with vendors to resolve transit discrepancies. The ideal candidate will also efficiently manage backorders alongside production teams to accelerate delayed shipments, maintaining a high level of urgency and customer satisfaction

Key Responsibilities

* 3PL Management: Monitor outbound order fulfillment at third-party logistics (3PL) warehouses. Ensure compliance with SLAs, resolve picking/packing delays, and audit inventory accuracy.

* Backorder Management: Track, prioritize, and manage backorders. Coordinate closely with production and inventory teams to expedite stock allocation and fulfill delayed shipments.

* Freight Booking & Routing: Secure freight capacity, negotiate spot rates, and schedule inbound/outbound shipments with carriers across multiple modes (TL, LTL, Ocean, Air)

* Delivery Tracking: Maintain and update the master delivery tracker. Proactively provide realtime updates and ETAs to key customer groups and account managers.

* 3PL Management: Monitor outbound order fulfillment at third-party logistics (3PL) warehouses. Ensure compliance with SLAs, resolve picking/packing delays, and audit inventory accuracy.

* Backorder Management: Track, prioritize, and manage backorders. Coordinate closely with production and inventory teams to expedite stock allocation and fulfill delayed shipments.

* Exception Handling: Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve transit delays, OS&D (Overages, Shortages, and Damages) claims, and customs clearance issues.

* Data & Documentation: Generate and review shipping documentation (BOLs, commercial invoices, packing lists). Maintain logistics metrics, including on-time delivery (OTD) and carrier performance.

* Freight Claims Handling: Process and manage freight claims from end to end, ensuring timely resolution and maximum cost recovery for damages, shortages, or losses.

QUALIFICATIONS:

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management or related field preferred.

* 4+ years of experience in purchasing, inventory management, logistics, or supply chain operations.

* Experience working with 3PL providers, freight carriers, and suppliers.

* Knowledge of inventory control, purchase order management, and freight claim processes.

* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUP, PivotTables, data analysis, reporting, and spreadsheet management

* Experience using ERP systems and inventory management software, with NetSuite experience preferred.

* High level of urgency, exceptional problem-solving skills, and the ability to communicate effectively with high-value customer groups under tight deadlines.

jobs.title: People Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Substack is building a new economic engine for culture, giving the brightest, most interesting, and most creative people on the internet the power of their own publishing platform. Substack empowers independent writers, artists, videographers, podcasters, and creators of all types to create, share, and make a living off their work through subscriptions, while offering them creative freedom, ownership, and a direct connection to their audiences.

**About the Role**  
Substack is looking for a People Operations Coordinator to support our People function at a pivotal stage of growth. You’ll help build the administrative backbone of the employee lifecycle: making sure offer letters go out, new hires are set up and ready on Day 1, leaves are processed, and records stay accurate.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Assist with onboarding and offboarding:** new-hire paperwork, I-9s, Day 1 logistics, and exit processing.
* **HRIS and data:** entering and updating employee records, and keeping them accurate.
* **Employee support:** answering first-line questions on policies, benefits and PTO, and routing the harder issues.
* **Benefits, payroll and leave:** coordinating enrollment, time off, leaves and claims paperwork.
* **Compliance and documentation:** keeping records, notices, handbooks and process docs audit-ready.
* **Recruiting support and culture:** interview scheduling, events, and review cycles.

**About You:**

* **2-4 years of experience** in People Operations, HR, recruiting coordination, or a similar operations role, ideally at a startup or fast-growing company.
* **Qualities:**

  + Detail-oriented and dependable. You treat sensitive employee data with care and never let a deadline or an I-9 slip.
  + Discreet and professional. You earn trust quickly and know what to handle yourself and what to escalate.
  + Resourceful and proactive. You spot what needs doing and fix broken processes instead of waiting to be asked.
  + Warm, clear communicator. You can answer a benefits question or a nervous new hire’s first-day question with equal care.
  + Comfortable with ambiguity and with changing priorities in a small, fast-moving team
* **Must have prior experience:**

  + Hands-on work with an HRIS (preferably HiBob) and with onboarding, offboarding, and employee records
  + Experience supporting recruiting (scheduling, ATS tools like Ashby)
  + Global experience with workforce infrastructures, including Sequoia One and Deel
  + Experience with performance management and compensation tools such as Pave and Confirm.
  + Familiarity with benefits administration, payroll processes, and leave management
  + Working knowledge of employment compliance basics, including I-9s and recordkeeping
* **Nice to have:**

  + HR certification (SHRM-CP, PHR) or coursework in HR
  + Experience supporting recruiting (scheduling, ATS tools like Ashby)
  + Experience with multi-state compliance or a distributed workforce

  *Substack’s compensation package includes a market-competitive salary, equity for all full-time roles, and exceptional benefits. Our cash compensation salary range for this role is* ***$90,000-$130,000.*** *Multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise, determine final offer amounts and may vary from the amounts listed above.*

Substack is an equal opportunity employer. If you want to see what media, communities, and content can become when unmoored from advertising models, and you have the skills and experience to contribute, we’d love to meet you.

jobs.description:
**About Shepherd Center**

With five decades of experience, Shepherd Center provides world-class clinical care, research, and family support for people experiencing the most complex conditions, including spinal cord and brain injuries, multi-trauma, traumatic amputations, stroke, multiple sclerosis, and pain. An elite center ranked by *U.S. News* as one of the nation’s top hospitals for rehabilitation, Shepherd Center is also recognized as both Spinal Cord Injury and Traumatic Brain Injury Model Systems. Shepherd is the only rehabilitation facility in the nation with an intensive care unit on-site, allowing us to care for the most complex patients and begin the rehabilitation process sooner. Shepherd Center treats thousands of patients annually with unmatched expertise and unwavering compassion to help them begin again.

Shepherd Center's culture is one of hope, humor, and hard work. You will enjoy career growth, strong relationships with co-workers, strong support from leadership, and fun activities that have kept over 12% of staff members working at Shepherd for more than 20 years.

Located in Atlanta, GA, this is a local, grant funded position.
  
Travel within the Atlanta Metro area is required.
  
The Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) is a research professional that facilitates and coordinates research studies. The CRC works alongside the principal investigator to ensure participant safety and study quality. The CRC is specifically responsible for participant recruitment, participant screening, study implementation, data collection and data management.

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**

The clinical research coordinator performs a wide range of professional, administrative, and evaluation responsibilities. The research coordinator will:

* Collaborate with the principal investigator and research/clinical teams to implement research studies.
* Develop high level of familiarity with the protocol, e.g., study proceedings and timelines, inclusion and exclusion criteria, confidentiality, privacy protections, etc.
* Implement recruitment strategies in accordance with IRB requirements and approvals.
* Perform participant screening activities to ensure participant eligibility per inclusion/exclusion criteria and investigator oversight.
* Perform consent discussions with eligible participants as part of the consenting process.
* Obtain informed consent from participant or Legally Authorized Representative alone and/or with the investigator.
* Perform assessments as qualified by training and experience such as vital signs, vision screening, sample collection, ECGs, etc.
* Administer surveys and questionnaires and perform standardized assessments.
* Perform source audits and meet with investigator regularly to resolve data queries and concerns.
* Transcribe data into the study data capture system.
* Manage data capture and data transfer.
* Schedule study visits, and coordinate staff, resources and ancillary services, as required.
* Provide education to participants and caregivers.
* Prioritize participant safety by reporting outcomes and adverse events to the investigator/sponsor in a timely fashion.
* Regularly report participant statuses to the investigator throughout research engagement.
* Review participant medical records and charts, as required.
* Generate and distribute resource materials for participants, caregivers, and staff.
* Develop systems, forms, and documents to efficiently collect data and implement studies.
* Collaborate with pharmacists for the dispensing and storage of investigational products (IP).
* Ensure best practices are followed in the management of IP for drug, device, and biologic studies.
* Collect, record, and prepare data for transmission to sponsor and/or publication.
* Prepare for and attend investigator meetings, sponsor monitoring sessions, site audits, and inspections. Ensure follow up actions are resolved.
* Communicate with Institutional Review Board(s) and manage submissions.
* Maintain regulatory documents for assigned studies.
* Develop working relationships with study sponsors, collaborating medical centers, and academic institutions.
* Maintain accurate time records for work performed on research studies.
* Order and track study supply inventories.
* Manage participant reimbursements and stipends.

*Other requirements:*

* Practices proper safety techniques in accordance with Shepherd Center and departmental policies and procedures. Responsible for the reporting of employee/patient/visitor injuries or accidents, or other safety issues to the supervisor and in the occurrence notification system.
* Monitors and ensures compliance with all regulatory requirements, organizational standards, and policies and procedures related to area of responsibility. Identifies potential risk areas within area of responsibility and supports problem resolution process.

**REQUIRED MINIMUM EDUCATION**

* Level I: Bachelor of Science in related field.
* Level II: Advanced Degree such as master’s in public health (MPH)
* Level III: Advanced Degree

**REQUIRED MINIMUM CERTIFICATION**

* Basic Life Support Certification (BLS)

**REQUIRED MINIMUM EXPERIENCE**

* Level I: Minimum of two (2) years clinical research experience required.
* Level II: Three (3) years clinical research experience and advanced degree.
* Level III: Five (5) years, advanced degree, and specialty certification(s).

**REQUIRED MINIMUM SKILLS**

* Completes orientation and initial assessment of competency successfully by determined due date.
* Completes mandatory education and annual competency assessment requirements by determined due date.
* Computer Competency including proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Familiarity with data storage and analysis systems helpful.
* Superior written communication skills.
* Flexibility to work shift per protocol demands.
* Basic testing competency (i.e. vital signs, collecting urine/blood specimens, specimen processing and shipping, ECG, etc.) per center

Hampton Lumber is a thriving family-owned company aspiring to be North America's preferred source for responsibly-sourced wood solutions. Headquartered in Portland, Oregon, we operate ten sawmills across Oregon, Washington, South Carolina, and British Columbia. We also manage timberland and operate a wholesale and import/export division.

Our mission is to grow, manufacture, and market renewable wood products and deliver innovative solutions for a more sustainable built environment. At Hampton Lumber, we accomplish this through our own operations as well as those of our affiliates—Trapa Forest Products, Idaho Timber, and RedBuilt. Our motto, "Find a better way every day," encapsulates our commitment to innovation and improvement across all operations.

We are guided by our core values:

* **Safety** – Prioritize safety across all operations.
* **Integrity & Authenticity** – Operate honestly and ethically while preserving our distinctive family-owned brand.
* **Responsible Stewardship** – Endeavor to balance and maintain economic, social, and environmental values in everything we do.
* **Tenacity** – Embrace challenges with grit, determination, and a can-do spirit.
* **Continuous Improvement** – Strive to enhance our processes, products, and people.
* **Customer Satisfaction** – Be nimble, responsive, and solutions-oriented.
* **Community Engagement** – Be a responsive, supportive, and respected member of the community.

With over 80 years in the sawmill business, we are proud to have cultivated the knowledge and experience needed to grow and prosper, even in challenging times. We always look to the future and invest in our people, new technologies, and continuous improvement processes and techniques.

  
Overview:

The Administrative Operations Coordinator serves as the central sales support and office operations resource for the Hampton Lumber Sales (HLS) Peachtree City office. This position is responsible for accurate and timely entry and processing of wholesale and mill sales orders, maintaining strong communication across sales and internal support teams, and coordinating the day-to-day administrative needs of the office.

Success in this role requires strong problem-solving ability, attention to detail, service-minded communication, and the initiative to anticipate needs before issues arise. This individual must be adaptable in a fast-paced sales environment, capable of balancing transaction accuracy with office responsibilities, and comfortable working independently while supporting a growing team.

Benefits Highlights:

* Substantial company-paid assistance for Medical and Dental insurance premiums; mental health coverage; cost effective co-pays and deductibles
* 401(k) with 5% annual company contribution and generous company matching contributions vested over three years
* Paid time off, including eight paid holidays
* Opportunity to earn bonuses
* Employee wellness program that includes free counseling sessions, financial and legal guidance, and more
* Opportunities for paid training to support career advancement and personal development

Responsibilities:

**Sales & Transaction Support:**

* Enter and process wholesale and mill sales orders, purchase orders, transfer orders, and related transactions accurately and efficiently
* Review daily order files and proactively identify discrepancies, missing information, or potential issues
* Maintain accurate order documentation and support timely completion of shipping- and invoicing-related processes
* Monitor order status and inventory information, coordinate necessary updates, and communicate changes to the appropriate sales and support partners
* Provide dependable day-to-day administrative support for the Peachtree City wholesale traders and mill sales team

**Cross-Functional Coordination:**

* Serve as a key communication link between sales personnel, the Fairfax mill, Traffic, Invoicing, Credit, Accounting, customers, and other internal partners to support accurate order flow
* Communicate clearly and assertively to resolve order questions, shipping discrepancies, documentation needs, and inventory concerns
* Coordinate information and follow-up across departments to prevent missed handoffs, delays, and recurring issues
* Build effective working relationships with the Portland support teams and other Hampton locations to ensure consistent service and alignment

**Office Administration & Facility Coordination:**

* Coordinate the day-to-day administrative operation of the Peachtree City office and help maintain an organized, professional, and welcoming work environment
* Monitor and replenish office, kitchen, and breakroom supplies, including making local purchases and supply runs as needed
* Coordinate with building management, cleaning services, maintenance providers, and other office vendors; communicate needs and follow through to resolution
* Support meeting and visitor logistics, including conference room readiness, refreshments, office access, and local coordination
* Maintain office records, vendor information, shared resources, and routine administrative processes
* Identify facility, equipment, technology, or supply needs and partner with the appropriate internal teams to address them
* Assist with onboarding logistics and administrative setup for new Peachtree City employees as the office grows

**Problem Solving & Process Ownership:**

* Identify potential transactional, documentation, inventory, or office-operation issues before they escalate

* Take ownership of assigned issues and follow through until resolution, keeping affected partners informed

The Key Account Manager will work to strategically manage, retain, and grow a book of assigned accounts. They support production & creative teams to ensure that client vision is successfully translated into the real world. The ideal candidate possesses a proven track record of managing complex activations, both physical and digital, and of aligning multiple project teams to deliver a creative vision and emerging as “the glue” for all project departments.

Strategic thinking, work ethic, and problem solving abilities are quintessential to this role.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Client & Account Ownership
* Manage day-to-day relationships across assigned key accounts
* Serve as a primary point of contact for clients and be the glue with internal teams and external partners
* Ensure high client satisfaction through proactive communication and solutions-oriented thinking
* Lead client planning calls on a regular basis and provides agendas, meeting minutes and regular budget updates
* Identify opportunities to grow existing accounts and deepen client partnerships

* Consult with clients on booth strategy, flow, layout, infrastructure, and execution approach
* Manage projects from briefing through post-show, ensuring scope, timelines, and expectations are aligned
* Support onsite execution
* Timeline, Project & Internal Coordination
* Create, publish, and manage pre-production timelines, ensuring all action items are communicated and completed prior to deadlines.
* Create & co-author onsite schedules to ensure all internal and external requirements are integrated into the larger production schedule
* Ensure clean handoffs across departments (design, production, graphics, invoicing)
* Document project requirements and updates in ET Global systems
* Anticipate risks and escalate challenges early to leadership with proposed solutions
* Candidate must be highly organized, self-motivated, and attentive to details.
* Financial Management
* Support budget oversight, estimates, and change orders
* Track revenue and ensure accurate scope documentation

**What We’re Looking For:**

* Experience managing client relationships in experiential, exhibits, events, or related industries
* Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple projects simultaneously
* Ability to collaborate across creative, production, and operational teams
* Confidence communicating with clients and internal stakeholders
* Willingness to travel and provide onsite leadership when required
* Desire to grow into a more senior, strategic role
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, CRM & project management software agnostic

Requirements:

* 6+ years of experience with experiential activations, tradeshows, or large-scale events
* Expertise in budget management and communicating change order processes with clients and internal teams for projects of all sizes
* Comfort reading CAD/technical drawings and discussing layout and AV considerations
* Experience in managing external vendors, logistics partners, and union labor crews both domestically and internationally

**Position Overview**

The Demand Generation & Marketing Coordinator will play a dual role in supporting the company's sales and marketing initiatives. This position will be primarily responsible for generating new business opportunities through outbound prospecting, lead development, and business development activities while also providing junior-level marketing support across campaigns, content development, digital marketing, and general marketing operations.

The ideal candidate is a self-motivated, organized, and proactive individual who enjoys both sales-oriented activities and creative marketing work. This person should be comfortable communicating with prospective customers, researching target markets, identifying new business opportunities, and supporting the execution of marketing initiatives.

This role requires consistent outbound cold calling and appointment setting, alongside supporting marketing initiatives.

This is an opportunity for someone looking to develop a career in sales, business development, and marketing while contributing directly to the company's growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Demand Generation & Business Development (60%)**

* Familiarity with LinkedIn and social media marketing.
* Basic experience with Canva, graphic design, or content management systems is preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Desired Skills & Attributes**

With more than 100 years of experience, Sika is a worldwide innovation and sustainability leader in the development and production of systems and products for commercial and residential construction, as well as the transportation, marine, automotive, and renewable energy manufacturing industries.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation industries toward greater environmental compatibility. Approximately 33,000 employees generated CHF 11.20 billion in sales in 2025.

* Self-starter with excellent organizational and territory management skills.

 **Qualifications**  

* Minimum 5 years outside sales experience with proven success;
* Extensive experience with Tile and Stone Installation Systems including tiles adhesives, tiles grouts, thin-sets and subfloor preparation in commercial & residential applications

* Bonuses

* Disability Insurance

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**

Swift Straw is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Customer Success Manager to join our team in our Atlanta, GA office. The Customer Success Manager will receive, process, and coordinate day to day orders for Swift Straw’s Wholesale and Manufacturing customers, support the Director of Customer Success in sales initiatives, foster customer relationship development, and serve as a dependable point of contact for our pine and wheat straw products in rolls, bales, and bags. This role includes managing customer orders across both divisions, identifying and closing new opportunities, and coordinating with the fulfillment team in Jasper and the wholesale logistics team so that every load is delivered when the customer needs it. Reporting directly to and working alongside the Director of Customer Success, the Customer Success Manager will share a book of customers with them, jointly manage those relationships, and handle the administrative tasks associated with the sales function.

**Responsibilities**

**Sales Order Management and Customer Relations**

* Accurately enter, track, and prioritize customer orders for both the Wholesale and Manufacturing divisions to ensure timely and efficient fulfillment.
* Ensure all customer orders and related information are promptly entered into company systems with full accuracy, maintaining up-to-date records for seamless order processing.
* Verify the accuracy of order details, pricing, payment terms, and ship to addresses in the system to prevent errors and ensure a smooth fulfillment process.
* Record customer credits in the system as soon as they are requested, before the resolution is worked, so that no credit request goes unlogged.
* Manage backorders, order changes, and split shipments, communicating revised timelines to customers before they have to ask.
* Develop an in-depth understanding of our pine and wheat straw products across rolls, bales, and bags to provide knowledgeable support and effectively address customer questions and feedback.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries, addressing questions and providing updates on order statuses, shipping timelines, and product information.
* Handle customer complaints professionally and efficiently, working towards effective solutions that enhance customer satisfaction.

  

**Fulfillment and Logistics Coordination**

* Work daily with the Manufacturing fulfillment team in Jasper to confirm bagged product availability, production timing, and load readiness.
* Coordinate with the Wholesale logistics team to schedule freight, sequence loads, and confirm delivery dates against customer requirements.
* Communicate accurate ETAs to customers and reset expectations clearly and early when timelines shift.
* Serve as the connection point between the customer, fulfillment, and logistics so that each load gets delivered when it is needed.
* Escalate supply, capacity, or delivery constraints to the Director of Customer Success early enough that the customer can still be given options.
* Work open credits through to resolution with the supply and logistics teams, following up until each one is closed out and keeping the customer informed along the way.

  

**Relationship Management and Opportunity Development**

* Share a book of customers with the Director of Customer Success, serving as the inside point of contact and partnering with them to manage and grow each relationship.
* Conduct regular outreach to strengthen customer relationships, identify evolving needs, and maintain customer loyalty.
* Use the CRM function in Salesforce to track opportunities through the pipeline, log activity, and drive opportunities to close.
* Identify and qualify new leads to expand Swift Straw’s customer base across distributors, yards, and retail accounts.
* Collaborate with the Director of Customer Success to nurture high-potential leads, developing tailored approaches and strategies to convert them into loyal customers.
* Maintain and update customer, contact, and ship to information in Salesforce and support other sales-related tools and systems.
* Prepare and share regular reporting on order activity, open opportunities, and account trends with the Director of Customer Success and the Director of Sales.

  

**Qualifications and Characteristics**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Management, Marketing, or a related field.
* Previous experience in an inside sales, customer service, or order management role preferred, ideally within manufacturing, agriculture, building products, or a similar industry.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook) and a willingness to learn and utilize Salesforce CRM and our manufacturing order system.
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly, concisely, and in a personable manner over the phone and in writing.
* Highly organized with attention to detail and a solution-oriented approach.
* Strong problem-solving abilities and capacity to handle challenging conversations professionally and effectively.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and manage changing priorities in a fast-paced, seasonal environment.
* Comfort working across two divisions with different products, customers, and fulfillment processes.
* Willingness and ability to travel periodically or on a limited basis to visit key customers alongside the Director of Customer Success.

  

**Position Impact**

* This position will work in a supportive and collaborative environment with an energetic, positive, and results-driven team.
* This position directly impacts customer satisfaction by delivering a superior customer experience and playing a key role in customer retention and growth.

jobs.description:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.

Newsweek Recognizes Sedgwick as America’s Greatest Workplaces National Top Companies

Certified as a Great Place to Work®

Fortune Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance

Sales Development Representative

**PRIMARY PURPOSE****:** The Sales Development Representative (SDR) builds and qualifies early-stage sales pipeline by researching priority accounts, identifying relevant buyers, executing coordinated outbound outreach, gauging prospect interest, and transferring complete, well-qualified sales leads to Business Development Directors. The SDR is accountable for generating qualified meetings and sales-accepted leads, improving conversion through the early stages of the funnel, and maintaining accurate activity and qualification data. This role does not lead discovery meetings or own opportunities after handoff.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Builds and prioritizes target-account lists based on approved market segments, intent signals, marketing engagement, events, and Business Development Director direction.
* Researches prospective organizations, relevant contacts, buyer roles, buying committees, and potential cross-sell opportunities.
* Uses approved customer relationship management, prospecting, marketing automation, sales-engagement, data, and AI-enabled research tools to identify business signals and personalize outreach
* Executes coordinated email, telephone, and professional networking outreach using approved messaging, sequences, and cadences.
* Assesses account fit, buyer relevance, business need or trigger, interest level, and approximate timing using agreed qualification and sales-acceptance criteria to determine whether a prospect should advance, remain in nurture, be rerouted, or be disqualified.
* Prepares clear and complete lead handoff documentation summarizing account context, relevant contacts, business need or trigger, interest level, timing, and recommended next steps.
* Coordinates qualified lead and meeting handoffs to Business Development Directors and supports scheduling, preparation, documentation, and follow-up as appropriate.
* Maintains accurate and timely CRM records, including prospecting activity, qualification information, lead status, source attribution, routing, and disposition.
* Follows established sales development processes, qualification criteria, routing requirements, and data quality standards.
* Meets established performance expectations for outreach activity, qualified meetings, sales-accepted leads, response timeliness, and CRM data accuracy.
* Incorporates coaching, handoff feedback, and prospect responses to improve research, outreach, messaging, and qualification effectiveness.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field from an accredited college or university preferred. Equivalent education and experience may be considered.

Two (2) years of experience in business development, sales support, account management, client engagement, recruiting, marketing, customer success, or another relationship-focused professional role, or an equivalent combination of education and experience required.

**Skills & Knowledge**

* Candidates must demonstrate the communication skills, learning agility, resilience, organization, and comfort with outbound prospecting required to succeed in the role. •
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including a confident and professional telephone presence. •
* Ability to tailor outreach to different organizations, industries, buyer roles, and business needs.
* Ability to learn Sedgwick services, buyer personas, market segments, and a complex business-to-business selling environment.
* Comfort with outbound prospecting, structured follow-up, high activity levels, and professional rejection.
* Ability to conduct account and contact research, recognize relevant business signals, and summarize findings clearly.
* Sound judgment in determining when to advance, nurture, reroute, or disqualify a prospect.
* Strong organizational, prioritization, time-management, persistence, and follow-through skills.
* Ability to accept coaching, apply feedback, and continuously improve prospecting and qualification practices.
* Familiarity with CRM, prospecting, marketing automation, sales-engagement, and AI-enabled research tools preferred.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with Business Development, Marketing, Capture Management, Revenue Operations, solution experts, and Sales leadership.
* Ability to work in a team environment and meet or exceed Performance Competencies.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

When applicable and appropriate, consideration will be given to reasonable accommodations.

**Mental****:** Clear and conceptual thinking ability; excellent judgment, troubleshooting, problem solving, analysis, and discretion; ability to handle work-related stress; ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously; and ability to meet deadlines

**Physical****:** Computer keyboarding, travel as required

**Auditory/Visual****:** Hearing, vision and talking

jobs.title: Independent Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**About Digital Ads Post**  
Digital Ads Post (DAP) is a growing local digital advertising network connecting businesses with customers through television screens in participating establishments. Our platform places still-image advertising in locations such as barbershops, salons, restaurants, automotive service centers, and professional offices.

**The Opportunity**  
Recruit local businesses to host DAP advertising on their existing television screens. You are not required to sell advertising packages. Your focus is securing qualified business locations where DAP can install and operate its advertising system. Participating hosts receive complimentary advertising exposure.

**Responsibilities**

* Identify and approach local businesses interested in hosting DAP.
* Explain the hosting benefits and present the opportunity to decision-makers.
* Secure completed host agreements and coordinate onboarding.
* Maintain accurate records of prospects and participating locations.
* Represent DAP professionally in the community.

**Compensation & Earning Potential**

* $75 one-time activation bonus per qualifying location.
* 10% recurring commission on eligible advertising revenue attributed to recruited locations, for up to 36 months while qualifying revenue continues.
* Activation bonus is payable after DAP collects qualifying paid advertising revenue and 30 days pass without refund or reversal.
* Recurring commissions are calculated after specified equipment recovery and monthly service expenses.
* This is a 100% commission-based independent contractor opportunity; no hourly wage or guaranteed salary.

**Illustrative Earnings**

Example: Secure just 20 qualifying host locations in one month. If each location generates $500 in monthly advertising revenue, that represents an estimated $940 per month in recurring commissions ($11,280 over 12 months), after the $30 monthly service expense per location and once equipment costs have been recovered. You may potentially receive residual commissions from those locations for up to 36 months while qualifying paid advertising continues. You could also earn $1,500 in one-time activation bonuses if all 20 locations qualify. This is an earnings illustration, not a guarantee; actual commissions depend on collected advertising revenue, applicable deductions, and eligibility.

**Qualifications**

* Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
* Comfortable approaching business owners and decision-makers.
* Self-motivated and able to work independently.
* Reliable transportation for local business outreach.
* Basic smartphone, email, and online-form skills.
* Sales, business development, or community outreach experience helpful but not required.

**Why Partner with DAP**

* Flexible schedule and opportunity to build recurring commissions.
* No advertising equipment or inventory purchases required by the representative.
* Straightforward offering for local businesses.
* Opportunity to help expand a growing local advertising network.

**Apply Today**

Apply through Indeed with your resume or a brief description of your sales or business development experience.

Website: www.digitaladspost.com | Email: contact@digitaladspost.com

*This is an independent contractor opportunity, not salaried or hourly employment. Compensation and eligibility are governed by a written independent contractor agreement.*

Kane/ DuPage Counties Outreach Coordinator

*Women, trans, gender non-conforming and queer folks, Black, Indigenous, People of Color (BIPOC), and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Live4Lali is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate by race, age, sex, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, sexual orientation, or disability in its procedures and policies. Involvement in the criminal justice system is not an automatic disqualifier. Live4Lali does not discriminate on the basis of any protected status, complies with the Illinois Human Rights Act, and provides reasonable accommodations as required by law.*

Substance use disorder continues to be a devastating public health crisis. Americans die from drug overdoses at a rate of roughly 210 to 300 people per day. In 2023, there were 105,007 total drug overdose deaths in the United States. In Illinois, 3052 residents died from an accidental drug overdose in 2023, which is more than twice the number of fatal motor vehicle accidents and more than twice the number of homicides. The increase in the number of fatalities is attributed to the rise of synth3etic opioids, such as fentanyl. Since 2013, synthetic opioid deaths in Illinois have increased 3,341%.

Live4Lali has been serving suburban Chicagoland for nearly sixteen years providing critical prevention, education, treatment access, support programs, community solutions-building initiatives, risk reduction, and overdose prevention services to decrease the devastating toll of the opioid epidemic. mission is to reduce stigma and prevent substance use disorder among individuals, families, and communities, and minimize the overall health, legal and social harms associated with substance use.\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

The Kane/Dupage Counties Outreach Coordinator reports to the Kane/DuPage Counties Program Manager and works collaboratively with other Outreach Coordinators. This role focuses on community-based outreach to provide education on risk reduction strategies, naloxone, and overdose prevention, while building trusting relationships with people who use substances. The Outreach Coordinator also provides peer-based support, drawing on lived experience to reduce harms associated with substance use and connect individuals to resources and support.

Under the direct supervision of the Kane/DuPage Counties Program Manager, the Full-Time (40 hours) Kane/Dupage Counties Outreach Coordinator will be part of the Live4Lali team, engaged in the following activities:

Core Responsibilities

* Identify areas of greatest need across Kane/Dupage Counties on the street and within existing services (such as our Mobile Outreach Program) to connect with participants and distribute risk reduction supplies
* Provide peer-based support to participants through rapport building, recovery coaching, risk reduction–informed interventions, and referrals, using lived experience to support participant-defined goals and reduce harms associated with substance use.
* Assist with stocking, maintaining, and delivering risk reduction inventory
* Accurately log and report data collected during outreach.
* Provide on the spot training and education in risk reduction, overdose response, and distribute naloxone, the opioid overdose reversal medication across the county
* Identify and collaborate with a range of organizations and entities including but not limited to treatment providers, housing providers, social service organizations, healthcare providers, businesses, government agencies, etc to scale up access to naloxone
* Develop and implement substance use prevention programs targeted at the community
* Develop and deliver professional education and trainings for community members, professionals, students, and the general public on overdose recognition and response, naloxone administration, substance use, and risk reduction practices
* Identify, build, and maintain relationships with community resources—including treatment providers, housing programs, social services, food access programs, and other supports—to develop partnerships and serve as referral and warm handoff resources for participants with identified needs
* Identify and develop safety plans with participants who are at increased risk of overdose
* Assess community needs in collaboration with participants and report to Program Manager to help develop appropriate programs
* Maintain confidentiality and HIPAA compliance at all times
* Identify and maintain appropriate communication with team regarding issues, observations, and opportunities
* Perform other duties as assigned

Desired Qualifications

The Kane/Dupage Counties Outreach Coordinator must be a person of lived experience preferably with at least 2 years in recovery/remission from substance use disorder. Being bilingual in Spanish is a plus. They will preferably also have a minimum of two years’ relevant work experience in substance use disorder, mental health, public health or social work. This candidate will demonstrate the following qualifications:

* Direct service delivery experience in the community social services sector with a demonstrated working knowledge of community-based programs and community support systems;
* Demonstrated ability to establish rapport with a diverse range of clientele including individuals who are actively using substances and living with significant health challenges;
* Proficiency in technology, including but not limited to Google Drive, Zoom, Microsoft Office Suite and GoToMeeting;
* Demonstrated attention to detail and strong organizational skills;
* Demonstrated knowledge in the areas of safer drug use, addictions, safer sex, sex work, HIV/AIDS, hepatitis C, mental health, etc.;
* Demonstrated knowledge of social justice, health promotion and public health approaches and models of social support and health care;

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Saucy Marketing is a full-service marketing agency built for the food and beverage world. We're a small, scrappy, creative team that believes great food deserves great marketing, and we bring a mix of curiosity, strategy, data, and (of course) flavor to everything we make. We're growing, and we want the right person to help us find our next great clients.

**Our Clients**

We work across the whole food and beverage ecosystem, and these are the brands you'll be getting in front of:

* Restaurants, bars, and cafés, from new concepts to established favorites
* Catering companies and event venues looking to fill their calendars and wow their guests
* Food and beverage CPG brands launching or refreshing products, packaging, and retail presence
* Food distributors and suppliers who need to stand out to the operators, buyers, and reps they sell to

**The Role**

We're looking for a Business Development Representative to be the first hello between Saucy and the food and beverage brands we're meant to work with. You find the right opportunities, start the conversation, and get us on a call with the person who makes the decision. Once that call is booked, we take it from there.

**What You'll Do**

* Identify food and beverage brands that are a strong fit for Saucy's services across our client categories
* Research each prospect to find the right decision maker, such as an owner, operator, founder, or marketing lead
* Reach out through email, LinkedIn, phone, and any other channel that works, with personalized messages that start real conversations
* Qualify interest by confirming the brand has a real marketing need, the authority to act on it, and a reason to talk now
* Book qualified discovery calls directly with the decision maker and our team
* Follow up persistently and professionally with prospects who haven't responded yet
* Log your prospects, outreach, and booked calls in our CRM so nothing slips through the cracks
* Share what you're hearing from the market so we can sharpen our outreach and offers

**What You Won't Do**

You are not responsible for closing. Once you've connected us with the decision maker, our team runs the discovery call, the proposal, and the sale. You won't need to pitch pricing, negotiate, or manage client accounts. Your job is to open the door and get us in the room.

**How You're Paid**

This role starts commission-only. You earn a commission for every client you bring to Saucy who signs, so your income grows with the quality of the conversations you start. There is no base salary to start. Once you've brought in five signed clients, we add a competitive base salary on top of your commission. We'll walk through the full structure with you during the interview process.

**What You Bring**

* Proven outreach skills: cold email, LinkedIn, phone, or all three, with a track record of turning cold conversations into booked meetings
* Comfort being told no, and the persistence to follow up without being pushy
* Strong written communication, with the ability to write messages that sound human and not like a template
* The ability to research a brand quickly and figure out who actually makes the decisions
* Excellent organization and follow-through, because you'll be managing your own pipeline
* Self-motivation and the drive to build your own income, with no one watching over your shoulder
* A genuine love of food and hospitality, and curiosity about how food and beverage businesses work!

**Major Plus**

We aren't expecting you to have everything!

* Experience selling marketing, creative, or agency services
* An existing network in restaurants, catering, CPG, or food distribution
* Familiarity with restaurant and food-service platforms such as Toast, MarginEdge, or similar POS and back-office systems
