jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**Executive Assistant Job Description**

**About The Bloc**

The Bloc is a free competitive boxing and youth development nonprofit in West Humboldt Park, Chicago. Since 2016 we've grown from 12 kids in a classroom to more than 450 fighters a year, ages 10 to 18, who train with us and grow academically, athletically, and as part of a community.

**This Role**

The Executive Assistant makes the Executive Director's time count. You'll run his calendar and communications, prepare him for every meeting that matters, and make sure what gets decided actually gets done. You'll also protect his time. The Bloc requires an Executive Director who is focused, strategic, and effective. Your organizational, communication, and tactical thinking will be key in creating the conditions for the organization’s success. You’ll also be someone the ED thinks out loud with. When he’s weighing a decision, you’ll bring what you know about the staff, the calendar, and what’s already been promised, and you’ll tell him what you think.

This is an in-person role at our gym, and it involves sensitive information about staff, the board, and funders. Discretion is part of the job.

**What You'll Own**

**Calendar, Organization, and Time**

* Own the ED's calendar: scheduling, rescheduling, and saying no on his behalf when a request doesn't fit his priorities.
* Protect standing personal time, family commitments, focus blocks, and time off
* Keep a weekly rhythm with the ED to review the week ahead, decide what needs his time, and route the rest to the right staff member.
* Plan travel and conference logistics, including summits and funder visits.
* Keep the ED's office systems, files, and processes documented so the office runs without depending on any one person.
* Notice where things get stuck in the ED’s office and fix the process, not just the instance.

  

**Communications**

* Triage the ED's inbox daily. Flag what needs him, draft responses for his review, and close out routine items yourself.
* Draft correspondence, thank-you notes, and follow-ups in the ED's voice.
* Serve as the first point of contact for funders, board members, partners, and press who reach out to the ED.
* Support social media content creation by capturing and editing simple video clips.

  

**Preparation and Follow-Through**

* Prepare a short brief before key meetings: bios of attendees, communication history, open items, and what the ED needs to walk out with.
* Capture decisions and action items in leadership meetings and follow up with owners until they're closed.
* Track the ED's commitments to staff, funders, and the board so nothing he promised

slips.

**Board and Funder Support**

* Coordinate board meeting logistics, compile board packets, and track board follow-ups with the Board Chair and Secretary.
* Maintain a funder touchpoint calendar for the ED, including reporting dates, site visits, and stewardship calls, in coordination with the development team.
* Support event logistics where the ED is hosting or speaking.

  

**Special Projects**

* Utilizing your existing or emerging skill set, engage in special projects to support The Blocs function or growth.

**What Success Looks Like**

**At 90 Days**

* You run the ED's calendar and inbox without him needing to check first.
* Every board meeting and major funder meeting has a brief prepared ahead of time.
* You track and follow up on action items from leadership meetings within a week.
* You have identified a
* special project that you will own to support The Bloc.

  

**At One Year**

* The ED spends most of his time on vision, funders, the board, and his team, and very little on logistics.
* The organization runs smoothly, deadlines are met, and initiatives progress when the ED is out.
* Staff, board members, and funders see you as a reliable, discreet point of contact for the ED's office.

  

**Who You Are**

* You have at least 3 years of experience supporting a senior leader, or running operations in a fast-moving environment.
* You keep confidential information confidential.
* You have good judgment. You can tell what needs the ED and what doesn’t, and make the call.
* You form your own opinions and share them, even when they differ from the ED’s.
* You're organized enough to hold a lot of moving pieces and confident enough to push back on a request when it doesn't fit the ED's priorities.
* You write clearly and can draft in someone else's voice.
* You're comfortable with Google Workspace, Zoom, Teams, and you pick up new tools quickly.
* You are exceptionally attentive to detail.
* You follow through. When you say something will get done, it gets done.
* You care about young people in Chicago and want your work to support them.

  

You don't need a degree. Experience in youth development, nonprofits, or athletics is a plus, and so is a connection to Chicago’s West Side.

  

**Compensation and Benefits**

The salary range is $60,000 to $75,000, based on experience. This is a full-time, exempt position reporting to the Executive Director.

* The Bloc pays 80% of BlueCross medical, dental, and vision premiums.
* Paid time off, with up to unused days paid out each year.
* A paid six-week extended leave after five years, under our staff sabbatical policy.

Most product, pricing, and marketing decisions never get tested before the money is spent. Neon Blue builds grounded simulated audiences of a company's customers and market, built from real human studies, so teams can test those decisions first.

We're a seed-stage company in San Francisco, hiring our first events lead. This is a senior individual-contributor seat. You report to the CEO, you run the program yourself, and you are not managing a team. You own the dinners and events we host, and our presence at conferences.

Construction is a multi-trillion-dollar industry facing a shortage of roughly 349,000 workers — and it still estimates by hand. Contractors spend weeks measuring and counting materials off drawings, and that caps how many jobs they can bid. Bobyard’s AI takes a contractor from a set of plans to a bid in minutes instead of weeks. Our customers run real construction jobs on Bobyard, not demos. We raised a $35M Series A led by 8VC, with Primary and Pear.

Builders. We ship real product to real contractors. If it doesn’t survive contact with a live job, it doesn’t count — we don’t do demo-ware.

Owners. There’s no layer between you and the problem, and no permission slip required. When you see the solution, you own it, end to end.

Independent minds. Strong convictions, open minds. We hire for how you think, not where you learned it — show us the work, not the résumé.

Fast movers. We decide quickly and optimize for impact, not consensus. You’ll be judged by the people in the problem with you, on what you deliver.

**About the role**

Our CSM team is growing faster than one leader can coach. You'll lead a pod of Customer Success Managers, own their retention and expansion numbers, and build the playbook the next pods will run on. You'll still take the hardest accounts yourself.

**What you'll do**

* Lead, coach, and hire a pod of CSMs, and set the bar for what good looks like
* Own your pod's gross and net revenue retention, and know where every account stands each week
* Spot stalling accounts early, and run the save plan yourself when it matters
* Drive renewals, upsells, and win-backs with your team
* Take customers from Implementation without a gap, and turn their feedback into product fixes with Product

new_jobs.title: Operations & Logistics Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**About Corvus**
----------------

We’re Corvus Robotics, a Physical AI company transforming how the world’s warehouses operate. By combining autonomous robotics, computer vision, and AI, we’re replacing manual, labor-intensive processes with intelligent systems that make inventory management safer, smarter, and more efficient.

Our flagship Corvus One drones autonomously track warehouse inventory around the clock, while Corvus Trident, our AI-powered forklift intelligence system, captures inventory movement in real time. Together, our technologies provide a complete picture of warehouse operations, helping enterprises improve accuracy, efficiency, and decision-making.

Our technology is widely deployed and delivering value for leading enterprises. We’re now building a future where warehouse operations are fully autonomous. At Corvus, you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, solve challenging real-world problems, and help bring the next generation of intelligent robots to scale.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a highly organized, resourceful, and hands-on Operations & Logistics Coordinator to support our growing robotics manufacturing operations.

You'll help keep our production and shipping operations running smoothly by managing inventory, coordinating purchasing, tracking incoming materials, and ensuring finished hardware reaches customers on time.

This is not a traditional desk-based logistics role. You'll be actively involved in day-to-day operations, working closely with manufacturing technicians, engineers, and vendors while managing both administrative and physical tasks.

The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys solving operational problems, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is equally comfortable managing purchase orders, organizing inventory, and preparing shipments.

This is a fully onsite role at our Mountain View headquarters, five days a week.

**What You'll Do**

* Manage day-to-day inventory operations, including receiving, organizing, tracking, and maintaining hardware components and supplies.
* Create, track, and manage purchase orders for manufacturing materials, tools, and equipment.
* Coordinate with vendors and suppliers to ensure timely delivery of parts and materials.
* Monitor inventory levels, identify shortages, and support procurement planning.
* Organize and maintain warehouse, storage, and manufacturing areas.
* Coordinate incoming and outgoing shipments, including packaging, labeling, documentation, and carrier scheduling.
* Work closely with manufacturing technicians and quality engineers to ensure materials and finished products are available when needed.
* Maintain accurate inventory records and update internal tracking systems.
* Assist with packing crates, preparing customer shipments, and safely moving hardware and equipment.
* Track shipping deadlines, resolve logistics issues, and communicate updates across teams.
* Support general office and operational needs as required.
* Identify opportunities to improve purchasing, inventory accuracy, shipping workflows, and operational efficiency.

**What We're Looking For**

* Experience in operations, logistics, inventory management, purchasing, shipping, or a related coordination role.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Experience managing multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfortable working with inventory tracking systems, spreadsheets, and operational software.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams.
* Willingness to handle both administrative responsibilities and hands-on physical tasks.
* Ability to safely lift, move, and organize boxes, equipment, and materials, with or without reasonable accommodation.
* Resourceful, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of day-to-day operational challenges.
* Ability to work onsite in Mountain View five days per week.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in robotics, hardware manufacturing, or startup operations.
* Familiarity with purchasing, inventory management, ERP systems, and shipping logistics.
* Experience coordinating warehouse operations and production workflows.
* Background in administrative or office operations with hands-on logistics experience.
* Familiarity with AI tools and process automation.

**Why Join Corvus Robotics?**

**Build technology that works in the real world.** Be part of a team bringing autonomous robotics and AI into real-world environments, solving meaningful challenges and transforming warehouse operations.

**Own your impact.** Take ownership of meaningful work, contribute to important decisions, and see the direct impact of your contributions as we grow.

**Help scale the next generation of Physical AI.** Join at a pivotal stage of growth and help build the technology, teams, systems, and processes that will bring autonomous robotics to enterprise scale.

**Grow alongside the company.** Work with talented, driven people across disciplines, tackle new challenges, expand your skills, and help shape the future of Corvus Robotics.

Compensation Range: $70K - $90K

new_jobs.description:
**Why Join ADAPT?**

It's more than a job; it's a calling. It's where passion meets purpose. ADAPT Community Network, formerly United Cerebral Palsy (UCP) of NYC provides a multitude of services to people with developmental disabilities. At ADAPT, we are 3,000 strong, and it takes every one of us to empower the lives of the people we support. With caring and great resources at hand, we know what it takes to help people live fuller, happier, healthier lives. Our employees show their commitment to the people we support every day, and we all deliver on our promise to provide innovative and comprehensive services to individuals with developmental disabilities.

For your next career move, apply with us at ADAPT Community Network! Wherever you work among our many locations around New York City, ADAPT offers paid training, competitive benefits, and we foster a team culture of learning, support, collaboration and career growth.

**SUMMARY**

Under the general direction of the program director or designee, the Residence Program Specialist is responsible for supporting the care, development, and independence of individuals living in an ADAPT Community Network residential facility. This role fosters dignity, respect, and learning while helping to create a safe, supportive, and homelike environment. The Residence Program Specialist provides direct support, skill-building, and advocacy to ensure that the people we support achieve their personal goals and enjoy the highest quality of life possible.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

The duties and responsibilities of the Residential Program Specialist will include, but are not limited to the following:

* Provides care and supports the people we support in achieving greater independence and personal development.
* Ensures the safety, health, and well-being of the people we support at all times.
* Teaches and assists with activities of daily living (ADLs), including self-help, social, and community living skills.
* Maintains a personalized, homelike, and respectful atmosphere within the residence.
* Participates actively in interdisciplinary treatment plans and implements individualized program goals.
* Documents daily activities, progress notes, incident reports, and other required records accurately and in a timely manner.
* Responds to crisis situations and medical emergencies, including providing first aid and contacting emergency personnel as needed.
* Contacts emergency personnel (police, fire, ambulance) when necessary to ensure safety of the people we support and staff.
* Ensures all actions are conducted in a manner that prevents abuse, neglect, or exploitation, and immediately reports any concerns in accordance with agency policy.
* Follows all OPWDD-approved behavior management guidelines, including use of approved interventions when required.
* Administers medications as an Approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP), following agency protocols and under nursing supervision.
* Provides transportation for the people we support to program, work, appointments, and recreational activities as needed.
* Assists with meal planning, grocery shopping, and meal preparation to promote nutrition and independence.
* Participates in housekeeping, laundry, and light maintenance tasks to ensure a safe, clean, and supportive environment.
* Attends and participates in staff meetings, trainings, and in-service sessions to support ongoing development and quality care.
* Promotes dignity, respect, and person-centered approaches in all interactions with the people we support, families, and staff.
* Maintains confidentiality of all resident information and documentation.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Six months of related experience is preferred but not required.
* Employees must be approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP) at time of hire or within six months of date of hire.
* Valid New York State Driver’s License, maintained in good standing
* Ability to read, write, speak and understand English.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills for working effectively with the people we support, families, coworkers, and community partners.
* Ability to respond appropriately to crisis situations and make sound decisions under pressure.
* Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and safeguarding the rights of the people we support.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

**COMPENSATION:** $20.17/hour (after probation) + Industry-Leading Benefits for all full-time employees.

**At ADAPT, we value diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, and belonging.** We strive to ensure that our employees are comfortable bringing their whole, authentic self to work and that the people we support can also be their authentic selves. We value diverse backgrounds, opinions, ideas, and ways of thinking. We aim to build an inclusive and diverse workforce that is empowered and supported with leaders who create diverse and inclusive teams. We continuously seek opportunities for the organization to foster a more positive, respected, united, and collaborative culture.

ADAPT Community Network is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Qualified candidates of diverse ethnic and racial backgrounds and status are encouraged to apply for vacant positions at all levels.

new_jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY  
The Bernikow JCC Staten Island’s Career Service’s department helps individuals prepare for and secure long-term employment through career counseling, job placement assistance, occupational training, education, and supportive services.  
  
ABOUT YOU  
You will connect residents to Career Services programs and help new participants get ready to start. The coordinator builds relationships with community partners, leads information sessions, guides participants through intake and enrollment, and facilitates orientation. The coordinator serves as the primary point of contact from initial inquiry through orientation and works with Career Services staff and training partners to ensure participants know what to expect, where to report, and whom to contact for support.  
  
WHAT YOU’LL DO  
**Community Outreach and Participant Engagement**

* Develop and carry out outreach plans to connect Staten Island residents with Career Services programs, including individuals who face barriers to employment or training.
* Build and maintain referral relationships with schools, community-based organizations, workforce providers, and other local partners. Share program information, eligibility criteria and enrollment timelines.
* Represent Career Services at community events, career fairs, open houses, and partner meetings. Lead in-person and virtual information sessions for prospective participants.
* Respond to inquiries by phone, email and in-person. Explain available programs, eligibility requirements and next steps in clear, accessible language.
* Track outreach activities, inquires, referrals and enrollment by referral source. Use the results to identify which outreach efforts are reaching prospective participants.

**Participant Onboarding**

* Guide incoming participants through intake forms, required documentation, eligibility verification and other steps needed before their program begins
* Maintain accurate and confidential participant records. Track outstanding requirements and follow up with participants before enrollment deadlines.
* Identify barriers that could delay a participant’s start, such as missing documents, transportation needs or technology access. Connect participants with appropriate staff or resources for assistance.

**Orientation and Program Transition**

* Plan and facilitate accessible in-person and virtual orientations for new participants. Revie program schedules, attendance and participation expectations, available supports and key contacts.
* Prepare and update welcome packets, orientation presentations, checklists and resource guides. Coordinate facility tours or virtual platform walkthroughs as needed.
* Track orientation attendance and completion. Follow up with participants who miss orientation or need help preparing for their first day.
* Gather participant feedback and use it to improve orientation materials, delivery and follow-up.

  
OUR REQUIREMENTS

* Bachelor’s degree in education, communication, public relations, human services, social work, business administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* At least one year of experience in community outreach, participant recruitment, enrollment, program coordination, workforce development or a related area.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to facilitate group sessions in person and online and explain program requirements clearly.
* Ability to build relationships with community partners and work respectfully with participants from varied backgrounds.
* Strong organization skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and maintain accurate records.

  
PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and spreadsheets. Experience with participant databases, case management systems, or enrollment platforms a plus.
* Ability to safeguard confidential information and follow program documentation and eligibility requirements.
* Availability to work occasional evenings or weekends for outreach events and orientations.

  
SALARY  
$50,000- $55,000 Annually, depending on experience and qualifications.
  
  
BENEFITS  
The JCC of Staten Island is committed to keeping you and your family healthy and happy through a comprehensive benefits program. Offerings include: subsidized options for Medical; offerings for Dental and Vision coverage, FSA and Dependent Care. We also offer free LTD, STD, Life Insurance, a Pension, 403B, generous program discounts, free membership, ample time off and much more!  
  
ABOUT US  
The Jewish Community Center of Staten Island was founded in 1929 with the goal of creating a home for the Jewish community by offering social, recreational, and educational activities. Over time, that mission expanded to help anyone who walked through the doors of any of our facilities. The JCC has become a true community center—not just for the Jewish community, but for the entirety of Staten Island.
  
  
Programs serve the needs we see in our community and are constantly expanding to meet new demand. We serve people of all walks of life, from young children to seniors and everyone in between. The JCC is proud to offer services that help improve the quality of life for people on Staten Island and beyond. We strive to help those in need as well as provide recreational and educational opportunities for our members.  
The JCC of Staten Island is dedicated to encouraging harmony throughout the community by providing facilities and programs that are open to all regardless of race, religion, creed, color, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or political affiliation. Everyone is welcome at the JCC.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Juicebox**

Juicebox is on a mission to help teams **win the talent war**.

In the age of AI, human ingenuity is the ultimate scarce resource. Recruiting is a zero-sum game where you either compete or lose.

Teams at Ramp, Notion, and leading AI labs use Juicebox to power their hiring, alongside **5,000+** customers from early-stage startups to Fortune 500 companies.

We are on the path to $100M in ARR **with 20%+ monthly growth**, powering thousands of searches every day and making Juicebox one of the fastest-growing AI SaaS companies in the world.

Juicebox has raised over **$116M** in funding from lead investors including Sequoia Capital, DST Global, and NFDG. Read more about our $80M Series B here. Additional investors in Juicebox include Y Combinator, Coatue, Bond, Lux, Verified Capital, and Committed Capital.

**About the Role**

Customer Success at Juicebox sits at the intersection of commercial ownership, AI workflow enablement, and customer strategy. CSMs own the full customer relationship—from onboarding and adoption to expansion and renewal—while serving as trusted advisors and AI workflow experts.

Our customers range from enterprise talent teams to startup founders, staffing firms, and VC talent partners. As a PLG business, customers start small and scale quickly, so you'll often be managing onboarding, expansion, and renewal motions simultaneously.

You'll help define what Customer Success looks like in an AI-first world at a hypergrowth company shaping a new category. Our customers love the product, embrace innovation, and genuinely enjoy partnering with us. You'll do it alongside a low-ego, collaborative team and work directly with a VP of CS who has built world-class organizations at Gong, Slack, and Zendesk.

**You Will…**

* Own a portfolio of customers and drive measurable outcomes across onboarding, adoption, expansion, and renewal.
* Lead customer success plans, align on key metrics, and ensure talent leaders realize value quickly.
* Drive adoption of AI-native workflows, guide change management, and help customers reach their first “aha” moment and beyond.
* Own commercial conversations, including renewals, pricing negotiations, and complex buying processes.
* Identify and close expansion opportunities across teams, stakeholders, and product offerings.
* Build trusted, multi-threaded relationships with end users, champions, TA Ops leaders, and hiring managers.
* Lead ROI discussions and QBRs that demonstrate impact and strengthen partnerships.
* Help define and improve the Customer Success playbook by identifying gaps, solving problems, and scaling best practices.
* Live or be willing to relocate to New York City

**You Have…**

* 3+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Sales with ownership of a revenue target and a portfolio of 75-150 accounts.
* A track record of exceeding commercial goals and driving customer growth.
* The ability to manage multiple customer conversations and priorities simultaneously.
* A builder mindset and comfort operating in ambiguity before a playbook exists.
* Executive presence and confidence engaging senior stakeholders.
* Experience in SaaS, consulting, HR tech, or talent tech; recruiting industry experience is a plus, not a requirement.

**Perks & Benefits for all Full Time Employees**

* **Top-of-market compensation** with meaningful equity, because everyone should share in our success.
* **Daily meals provided:** breakfast catering, lunch order via DoorDash corporate, and for those who like to work late, dinner if staying after 7pm

**For US Employees:**

* **Comprehensive healthcare** with 100% employer-paid medical coverage for employees (PPO Platinum plan with $0 deductible). 90% employer contribution for dependents. Dental & Vision: 90% employer covered; 85% for dependents.
* **$2,000 annual wellness stipend** to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being.
* **$300/month commuting stipend** to help cover the cost of getting to and from the office.

**For UK Employees:**

* **Comprehensive private medical insurance** with £0 excess, full outpatient cover, comprehensive cancer care, mental health treatment, and 24/7 GP access.
* **£1,500 annual wellness stipend** to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being
* **£3,500/year commuting stipend** to help cover the cost of getting to and from the office.

Compensation Range: $165K - $230K

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Strategic
new_jobs.description:
**About Ramp**
==============

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the team and role**
---------------------------

Ramp’s Strategic Lifecycle Success team helps our largest and most complex customers turn their investment in Ramp into lasting business impact. After initial onboarding and implementation are complete, we help customers deepen adoption, continuously improve their Ramp setup, and successfully launch and activate additional products as their needs evolve.

As a Strategic Lifecycle Customer Success Manager, you’ll be a hands-on product expert and trusted partner to the finance, accounting, and operations teams using Ramp. You’ll own the ongoing customer success plan, proactively improve workflows, and lead onboarding and implementation when existing customers adopt new Ramp products. You’ll also lead adoption and value-focused business reviews, connecting how customers use Ramp to the outcomes that matter to their business.

You’ll work alongside an Account Manager, who owns commercial strategy and executive relationships, and partner with Solutions Consultants and Technical Consultants on complex technical needs. Your focus is helping customers get more from Ramp over time—from optimizing what’s already live to making each new product rollout successful.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* **Own ongoing success planning for a portfolio of customers.** After a structured handoff from initial onboarding and implementation, partner with a dedicated Account Manager to align on customer goals and define clear milestones, owners, and measures of success.
* **Serve as a trusted Ramp product expert.** Stay current on new products, capabilities, and best practices, and proactively translate relevant releases into recommendations for each customer.
* **Continuously enhance customers’ Ramp environments.** Understand their configuration and business processes, identify opportunities to improve policies, controls, approval flows, and workflows, and work hands-on with customers to put those improvements into practice.
* **Lead new-product implementations for existing customers.** Own discovery, planning, configuration, training, launch, and sustained adoption, aligning customer goals, owners, and milestones. Lead standard workflow improvements; partner with Solutions Consultants on complex design and validation, Technical Consultants on integrations, APIs, ERP connections, and data flows, and Support on troubleshooting and defect escalation. Specialists own diagnosis and execution; you own customer communication, cross-functional follow-through, and validation of outcomes.
* **Lead adoption and value-focused business reviews.** Define success measures and establish baselines with customers, then track improvements in adoption, spend consolidation, operational efficiency, and controls to demonstrate the value of their Ramp investment. Run regular adoption reviews with day-to-day stakeholders and partner with the Account Manager on executive QBRs and EBRs. Bring in the Account Manager or Solutions Consultant when useful, and coordinate joint reviews for Tier 1 accounts. Use evidence of progress to agree on next priorities.
* **Build customer champions and drive change.** Develop a network of champions across finance, accounting, AP, operations, and business units. Create enablement and change-management plans, including train-the-trainer approaches where useful, that equip customer teams to adopt new capabilities and sustain new ways of working beyond individual stakeholders.
* **Manage customer health proactively.** Monitor adoption, engagement, outcomes, and delivery risks; identify barriers early; and lead action plans to improve customer health. Equip your Account Manager with value evidence for renewal and growth conversations.
* **Identify customer success qualified leads (CSQLs).** Recognize growth signals through customer relationships, product usage, and evolving business needs, and qualify and proactively surface expansion opportunities to your Account Manager with clear customer context, value evidence, and recommended next steps. The Account Manager owns commercial strategy and execution.
* **Shape a repeatable lifecycle success motion.** Partner with Solutions Consultants, Technical Consultants, Support, and Product to resolve blockers and build playbooks for ongoing optimization and new-product activation. Translate recurring customer needs and workflow gaps into actionable feedback for Product, and close the loop with customers on relevant developments without making unconfirmed roadmap commitments.

**What you need**
-----------------

* A track record in enterprise customer success, including hands-on ownership of implementation, adoption, and ongoing value realization for complex customers.
* Strong product aptitude and experience configuring and optimizing software to support customer business processes—not just advising from a distance.
* Experience managing customer-facing implementations, from discovery and project planning through training, launch, and sustained adoption.
* Th

new_jobs.title: Associate, Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.

BitGo is seeking an Associate Customer Success Manager to support our Start up/Growth client segment, working with a high volume of clients introduced through our Sales organization. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving problems, building client relationships, and delivering responsive, high-quality service in a fast-paced environment.

Unlike Senior Customer Success roles focused on managing a smaller portfolio of strategic & enterprise accounts, this position will emphasize efficient management of a broad client base, providing proactive and reactive client support, and issue resolution. You will partner closely with Sales, Support, Operations, and other internal teams to help clients navigate BitGo's products and services, resolve challenges, and get the most value from their relationship with BitGo.

This role also offers a defined opportunity for career growth, with the potential to progress into a Customer Success Manager position managing a smaller portfolio of dedicated clients as you develop deeper product expertise and demonstrate strong client ownership.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Client Relationship Management**

* Manage a high-volume portfolio of Start up/Growth clients, serving as a primary point of contact for day-to-day questions, requests, and follow-ups.
* Respond to client inquiries in a timely, professional, and solutions-oriented manner.
* Build strong working relationships with clients while maintaining consistent communication and a positive client experience.
* Help clients understand BitGo's products, services, workflows, and available resources.

### **Client Support & Issue Resolution**

* Triage incoming client questions and issues, determine appropriate next steps, and coordinate resolution with internal teams.
* Track open requests and follow through to ensure clients receive timely updates and clear outcomes.
* Identify recurring client issues, service gaps, and opportunities to improve processes or client communications.
* Escalate complex, sensitive, or business-critical matters to the appropriate Customer Success, Support, or Operations stakeholders.

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Sales to support clients following onboarding and initial commercial engagement, ensuring a smooth transition into ongoing client management.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, and other teams to help address client needs and remove friction.
* Keep internal systems and client records up to date, documenting interactions, outstanding issues, and relevant account activity.
* Surface client feedback and emerging trends to help improve BitGo's products, processes, and service delivery.

### **Operational Excellence**

* Manage a high volume of client requests while prioritizing effectively and maintaining a high standard of service.
* Use established workflows, documentation, and internal resources to resolve common questions efficiently.
* Monitor client engagement and recurring support needs to identify potential risks, opportunities, and accounts requiring additional attention.
* Contribute to scalable processes that improve response times, consistency, and the overall client experience.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Experience & Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in Customer Success, client services, account coordination, customer support, sales support, or a similar client-facing role.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain information clearly and professionally.
* Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple client requests and competing priorities simultaneously.
* A client-first mindset with strong follow-through, sound judgment, and a bias toward resolving problems.
* Comfort working in a high-volume, fast-paced environment where responsiveness and execution are essential.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms and client management tools; experience with Salesforce is a plus.
* Interest in digital assets, cryptocurrency, financial services, or fintech, with a willingness to develop deeper product knowledge.

### **Leadership & Operating Style**

* **Client-focused:** Takes ownership of client questions and works to deliver a reliable, positive experience.
* **Responsive and resourceful:** Moves quickly, identifies solutions, and knows when to escalate.
* **Highly organized:** Keeps accurate records, manages follow-ups, and ensures requests do not fall through the cracks.
* **Collaborative:** Works effectively across teams to solve problems and advocate for client needs.
* **Growth-oriented:** Seeks feedback, builds product expertise, and demonstrates the initiative to take on increasing responsibility.
* **Adaptable:** Comfortable balancing a high volume of routine requests with unexpected or time-sensitive issues.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience supporting institutional clients or customers in fintech, financial services, payments, or digital assets.
* Familiarity with digital asset custody, wallets, trading, staking, or blockchain infrastructure.
* Experience supporting client onboarding, account activation, or post-sales relationship management.
* Expe

new_jobs.description:
**Location: New York, New York**
  
**Job Type: Contract**
  
**Compensation Range: $50 - 60 per hour**
  
  
Our client is seeking a Digital Marketing Project Manager to lead the planning, coordination and delivery of integrated initiatives across paid media, owned channels and content production. This role will serve as the project management backbone for the team's marketing activity, bringing structure, accountability and momentum to initiatives involving multiple internal stakeholders, agencies and external partners.
  
  
The Project Manager will translate marketing priorities into clear, actionable project plans; manage timelines, deliverables, dependencies and approval processes; and ensure teams have the information and resources needed to deliver high-quality work on schedule. The role will work across paid media campaigns, owned-channel programs and content development, helping connect these workstreams so that integrated initiatives are planned and executed cohesively. While the role will primarily support integrated marketing campaigns and content, the Project Manager may also lead website, digital platform and other cross-functional projects as business needs require, partnering closely with Digital Marketing Operations and Technology on initiatives with a technical component.
  
  
This is a highly collaborative role for an organized, proactive and solutions-oriented project leader who can bring structure to complex initiatives, anticipate obstacles and keep multiple workstreams moving forward simultaneously.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Lead end-to-end project management for integrated marketing initiatives across paid media, owned channels and content production, translating marketing priorities into clear project plans, timelines and deliverables.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects, coordinating dependencies across each to ensure content and creative development, stakeholder approvals, activation and execution are seamless.
* Serve as the central source of truth for project status; proactively identify risks and bottlenecks, drive resolution and ensure stakeholders understand upcoming milestones, decisions and actions required.
* Manage workflows supporting paid and owned media campaigns, coordinating across internal stakeholders, media agencies, creative partners and other external vendors to ensure deliverables and approvals remain on track.
* Hold internal teams and external partners accountable to agreed deliverables and deadlines while maintaining productive working relationships.

In this role, you will serve as the central hub for our logistics pipeline, ensuring seamless freight booking and routing while managing the end-to-end freight claims process for cost recovery. You will be directly responsible for maintaining our master delivery tracker to provide real-time updates to key customer groups, monitoring outbound order fulfillment across 3PL warehouses, and collaborating with vendors to resolve transit discrepancies. The ideal candidate will also efficiently manage backorders alongside production teams to accelerate delayed shipments, maintaining a high level of urgency and customer satisfaction

Key Responsibilities

* 3PL Management: Monitor outbound order fulfillment at third-party logistics (3PL) warehouses. Ensure compliance with SLAs, resolve picking/packing delays, and audit inventory accuracy.

* Data & Documentation: Generate and review shipping documentation (BOLs, commercial invoices, packing lists). Maintain logistics metrics, including on-time delivery (OTD) and carrier performance.

* Freight Claims Handling: Process and manage freight claims from end to end, ensuring timely resolution and maximum cost recovery for damages, shortages, or losses.

QUALIFICATIONS:

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management or related field preferred.

**Real Estate Transaction and Legal Coordination**
--------------------------------------------------

* Prepare routine correspondence and documents using approved templates under the direction of management or outside counsel.

* Assist with maintaining company records, authorizations, and resolutions in coordination with counsel.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Relevant experience as an executive assistant, legal assistant, paralegal, commercial real estate transaction coordinator, or in a similar support role.
* Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to draft professional correspondence and proofread accurately.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work independently.
* Professional judgment and discretion when handling sensitive business, financial, and legal information.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, PDF editing tools, and electronic signature platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* **Experience as a paralegal or legal assistant****, Associate in a real estate law firm.**
* Familiarity with commercial real estate acquisitions, financing, development transactions, or closings.
* Working knowledge of real estate transaction documents, due diligence procedures, and closing processes.
* Experience supporting a company principal, CEO, or senior executive.
* A law degree or paralegal certificate or relevant educational background; equivalent professional experience is welcome.

**Who Will Succeed in This Role**
=================================

You are someone who anticipates needs, asks thoughtful questions, and follows through without repeated reminders. You are comfortable handling both everyday administrative tasks and detailed transaction work. You communicate professionally, stay organized as priorities change, and understand the importance of accurate documents and timely execution.

**How to Apply**
================

Please send your résumé and a brief introduction to **hr@mckinleyhomes.com**with the subject line **“Executive Assistant Application – Your Name.”**  
In your introduction, please highlight any experience with real estate law firms, transaction coordination, or executive support.

new_jobs.title: Business Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Saucy Marketing is a full-service marketing agency built for the food and beverage world. We're a small, scrappy, creative team that believes great food deserves great marketing, and we bring a mix of curiosity, strategy, data, and (of course) flavor to everything we make. We're growing, and we want the right person to help us find our next great clients.

**Our Clients**

We work across the whole food and beverage ecosystem, and these are the brands you'll be getting in front of:

* Restaurants, bars, and cafés, from new concepts to established favorites
* Catering companies and event venues looking to fill their calendars and wow their guests
* Food and beverage CPG brands launching or refreshing products, packaging, and retail presence
* Food distributors and suppliers who need to stand out to the operators, buyers, and reps they sell to

**The Role**

We're looking for a Business Development Representative to be the first hello between Saucy and the food and beverage brands we're meant to work with. You find the right opportunities, start the conversation, and get us on a call with the person who makes the decision. Once that call is booked, we take it from there.

**What You'll Do**

* Identify food and beverage brands that are a strong fit for Saucy's services across our client categories
* Research each prospect to find the right decision maker, such as an owner, operator, founder, or marketing lead
* Reach out through email, LinkedIn, phone, and any other channel that works, with personalized messages that start real conversations
* Qualify interest by confirming the brand has a real marketing need, the authority to act on it, and a reason to talk now
* Book qualified discovery calls directly with the decision maker and our team
* Follow up persistently and professionally with prospects who haven't responded yet
* Log your prospects, outreach, and booked calls in our CRM so nothing slips through the cracks
* Share what you're hearing from the market so we can sharpen our outreach and offers

**What You Won't Do**

You are not responsible for closing. Once you've connected us with the decision maker, our team runs the discovery call, the proposal, and the sale. You won't need to pitch pricing, negotiate, or manage client accounts. Your job is to open the door and get us in the room.

**How You're Paid**

This role starts commission-only. You earn a commission for every client you bring to Saucy who signs, so your income grows with the quality of the conversations you start. There is no base salary to start. Once you've brought in five signed clients, we add a competitive base salary on top of your commission. We'll walk through the full structure with you during the interview process.

**What You Bring**

* Proven outreach skills: cold email, LinkedIn, phone, or all three, with a track record of turning cold conversations into booked meetings
* Comfort being told no, and the persistence to follow up without being pushy
* Strong written communication, with the ability to write messages that sound human and not like a template
* The ability to research a brand quickly and figure out who actually makes the decisions
* Excellent organization and follow-through, because you'll be managing your own pipeline
* Self-motivation and the drive to build your own income, with no one watching over your shoulder
* A genuine love of food and hospitality, and curiosity about how food and beverage businesses work!

**Major Plus**

We aren't expecting you to have everything!

* Experience selling marketing, creative, or agency services
* An existing network in restaurants, catering, CPG, or food distribution
* Familiarity with restaurant and food-service platforms such as Toast, MarginEdge, or similar POS and back-office systems
* Experience using a CRM like HubSpot to track outreach and pipeline

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off
* Referral program

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience selling professional services?

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chicago, IL 60657
